papers.q2_zh: SkillLens 从交互轨迹构建视觉技能卡并在推理时检索；CardDistill 让学生在不使用卡片的情况下行动，由能看到卡片证据（特权上下文）的教师对学生生成的 token 进行监督。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Multimodal-Mind2Web 和 WebLINX-BrowserGym 上评测，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 执行器与 Qwen3-VL-2B 学生。
papers.q4_zh: 蒸馏只是以检索为核心的系统的一部分，收益依赖卡片构建与检索质量；评测仅限网页基准。

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.q1: GUI grounding models are frozen after deployment and cannot adapt to unseen interfaces; test-time RL approaches cannot learn from failed explorations.
papers.q2: The model predicts coordinates on unseen interfaces, an MLLM Reflector evaluates them and writes reflections, and a self-teacher conditioned on those reflections gives token-level supervision on the student's outputs; contrastive calibration guards against wrong prefixes.
papers.q3: Evaluated on six GUI grounding benchmarks, reporting an average 7.4% accuracy gain over the base model.
papers.q4: Performance depends on the quality of the Reflector's judgments, and the method addresses grounding only, not full multi-step GUI tasks; code is not yet released.
papers.q1_zh: GUI 定位模型部署后参数冻结，无法适应未见过的界面；已有的测试时强化学习方法无法从失败的探索中反思学习。
papers.q2_zh: 模型在未见界面上预测坐标，MLLM 反思器评估结果并给出反思，以反思为条件的自教师在学生输出上提供 token 级监督；对比校准避免错误前缀污染监督信号。
papers.q3_zh: 在六个 GUI 定位基准上评测，相对基座模型平均准确率提升 7.4%。
papers.q4_zh: 效果依赖反思器判断的质量，且只针对定位而非完整的多步 GUI 任务；代码尚未发布。

papers.title: FIRE-VLA: Failure-Informed Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.q1: GRPO for driving VLAs learns from reward differences within a rollout group, so when every sampled trajectory is poor it ranks failures without pointing to better behavior.
papers.q2: Low-reward, low-diversity groups trigger self-distillation from a frozen round-start copy of the model that sees the hidden future trajectory; supervision follows the student's generated prefix on answer tokens while GRPO continues.
papers.q3: Qwen2.5-VL-3B on nuScenes, tested on 6,019 examples from 150 held-out scenes.
papers.q4: Gains come mainly from fewer rare severe failures rather than uniform improvement, and evaluation is open-loop planning on nuScenes only.
papers.q1_zh: 驾驶 VLA 的 GRPO 依赖组内奖励差异学习，当所有采样轨迹都很差时，只能对失败排序而无法指出更好的行为。
papers.q2_zh: 低奖励且低多样性的组会触发自蒸馏：教师是本轮开始时冻结的同一模型副本，可看到隐藏的未来轨迹；监督沿学生生成的前缀作用于答案 token，同时 GRPO 保持生效。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，在 nuScenes 的 150 个留出场景共 6,019 个样本上测试。
papers.q4_zh: 改进主要来自减少少数严重失败而非整体均匀提升，且评测仅为 nuScenes 上的开环规划。

papers.title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
papers.q1: Accelerated world action model students can lose task capability during distillation and meet states poorly covered by offline data.
papers.q2: The student WAM acts in the environment, so it determines the history distribution; a frozen teacher labels those histories with video and action targets, and joint video/action losses plus a flow-matching regularizer update lightweight adapters.
papers.q3: Preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 studies on two tasks using the one-step Flash-WAM student.
papers.q4: The authors describe the results as an initial capability proof on two tasks, not evidence of broad generalization.
papers.q1_zh: 加速后的世界动作模型学生在蒸馏中可能丢失任务能力，并会遇到离线数据覆盖不足的状态。
papers.q2_zh: 学生 WAM 在环境中行动，从而决定历史分布；冻结教师为这些历史标注视频与动作目标，联合视频/动作损失和流匹配正则共同更新轻量适配器。
papers.q3_zh: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的两个任务上，对单步 Flash-WAM 学生做了初步实验。
papers.q4_zh: 作者表示结果只是两个任务上的初步能力验证，不能说明具有广泛泛化性。

papers.title: ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
papers.q1: Physical AI needs a single model that grounds vision and language in real environments while also handling planning, interaction and outcome assessment across digital and physical tasks.
papers.q2: ME-VLM (4B and 35B-A3B) is trained by embodied capability injection, separate RL of an embodied expert and a multimodal-agent expert, then multi-teacher on-policy distillation in which the student's rollouts are supervised by both experts.
papers.q3: Evaluated on embodied and agent benchmarks plus autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks; the 4B variant runs on-device on the M100 chip.
papers.q4: Highly interactive tool use and long-horizon agent tasks are noted as remaining directions, and OPD is one stage of a larger pipeline.
papers.q1_zh: 物理 AI 需要一个统一模型，既能把视觉与语言落地到真实环境，又能在数字与物理任务中完成规划、交互与结果评估。
papers.q2_zh: ME-VLM（4B 与 35B-A3B）先进行具身能力注入，再分别用 RL 训练具身专家和多模态智能体专家，最后通过多教师在策略蒸馏，让两位专家监督学生的 rollout。
papers.q3_zh: 在具身与智能体基准以及自动驾驶、具身导航任务上评测；4B 版本可在 M100 芯片上端侧推理。
papers.q4_zh: 高交互工具使用与长程智能体任务仍是待改进方向，且 OPD 只是整个训练流程中的一个阶段。

papers.title: Learn How to Act from Your Own Interactions: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Agents
papers.q1: OPSD works well for GUI grounding, but extending it to multi-turn GUI agents is hindered by self-teachers that follow privileged guidance poorly and by insufficient guidance.
papers.q2: GUI-SD-v2 first strengthens privilege following by jointly optimizing rollouts with and without privileged guidance from the same GUI states, then selectively distills step-specific reasoning and memory guidance from a privilege-conditioned self-teacher.
papers.q3: Evaluated on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld with Pass@1 and Pass@3 success rates.
papers.q4: Evaluation covers mobile benchmarks only, and code and training data are promised but not yet released.
papers.q1_zh: OPSD 在 GUI 定位上效果很好，但扩展到多轮 GUI 智能体时，自教师对特权信息的遵循能力有限且特权指导不足。
papers.q2_zh: GUI-SD-v2 先在相同 GUI 状态下联合优化带与不带特权指导的 rollout 以增强特权遵循，再通过以特权为条件的自教师选择性蒸馏逐步的推理与记忆指导。
papers.q3_zh: 在 AndroidWorld 和 MobileWorld 上评测 Pass@1 与 Pass@3 成功率。
papers.q4_zh: 评测仅覆盖移动端基准，代码与训练数据承诺公开但尚未发布。

papers.title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
papers.q1: Multi-step embodied plans can create physical risks through subtask dependencies and environment interactions, which existing guardrails and per-subtask safety detectors miss.
papers.q2: PlanGuard judges a whole plan given the visual environment and instruction; after SFT on the MSP-Safe dataset, STAC-OPD distills token-level distributions from a strong teacher on the student's own outputs and adds probability-routed sequence-level compensation.
papers.q3: Trained and tested on the constructed MSP-Safe dataset; PlanGuard-2B reaches 87.15% accuracy and 87.21% F1 on average.
papers.q4: It is a pre-execution safety classifier rather than an acting agent, evaluated on a constructed dataset; code and data are not yet released.
papers.q1_zh: 具身任务的多步计划可能因子任务依赖和环境交互产生物理风险，现有护栏和逐子任务的安全检测器会漏掉这类组合风险。
papers.q2_zh: PlanGuard 根据视觉环境和指令评估完整计划；在 MSP-Safe 上 SFT 后，STAC-OPD 在学生自身输出上蒸馏强教师的 token 级分布，并加入按概率路由的序列级补偿。
papers.q3_zh: 在自建的 MSP-Safe 数据集上训练和测试；PlanGuard-2B 平均准确率 87.15%、F1 87.21%。
papers.q4_zh: 它是执行前的安全判别器而非行动智能体，只在自建数据集上评测；代码与数据尚未发布。
papers.affiliation: Anhui Key Lab of Digital Security

papers.title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Raising a pretrained world action model to expert level on a target task without degrading its other skills is hard, and on-policy distillation normally needs costly repeated environment rollouts.
papers.q2: A task-specific teacher supervises fresh denoising paths produced by the current student on histories from a fixed pool of mainly initial-student rollouts; prefix-weighted trajectory replay reweights losses with proxy importance weights to offset history shift.
papers.q3: Simulated and real-world robot manipulation experiments, measuring target-task gains and retention on tasks excluded from adaptation.
papers.q4: Because environment trajectories are replayed rather than re-collected, the method is only approximately on-policy and relies on proxy importance weights.
papers.q1_zh: 在不损害已有技能的前提下把预训练世界动作模型在目标任务上提升到专家水平很困难，而在策略蒸馏通常需要代价高昂的反复环境采样。
papers.q2_zh: 任务专用教师监督当前学生在固定轨迹池（主要是初始学生 rollout）的历史上新生成的去噪路径；前缀加权轨迹回放用代理重要性权重重新加权损失，以缓解历史分布偏移。
papers.q3_zh: 在仿真和真实机器人操作实验中，衡量目标任务提升及未参与适配任务的保持情况。
papers.q4_zh: 由于环境轨迹是回放而非重新采集，方法只是近似在策略，并依赖代理重要性权重。

papers.title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
papers.q1: GRPO training of multi-turn VLM agents gives no gradient when all rollouts fail and assigns credit only at episode level, and why OPD/OPSD helps there is poorly understood.
papers.q2: Rollback probes show gains come from restoring state at the pivot step; PIVOT has an Analyzer locate the pivot in failed student trajectories, a detached Teacher re-score failed tokens under that diagnosis, and the Student optimize GRPO plus confidence-gated OPD.
papers.q3: Five multi-turn VLM agent tasks spanning grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen3-VL-2B.
papers.q4: Results depend on the accuracy of the Analyzer's pivot diagnosis and are obtained with small VLMs in simulated benchmarks.
papers.q1_zh: 多轮 VLM 智能体的 GRPO 训练在所有 rollout 失败时没有梯度，且只能做回合级信用分配，而 OPD/OPSD 为何有效尚不清楚。
papers.q2_zh: 回滚探针表明收益主要来自在关键步恢复状态；PIVOT 让分析器在学生失败轨迹中定位关键步，分离的教师在该诊断下重新为失败 token 打分，学生联合优化 GRPO 与置信度门控的 OPD。
papers.q3_zh: 在涵盖网格谜题、3D 具身控制与导航、生成式推理的五个多轮 VLM 智能体任务上，使用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 和 Qwen3-VL-2B 评测。
papers.q4_zh: 效果依赖分析器关键步诊断的准确性，且结果来自仿真基准上的小型 VLM。

papers.title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.q1: Online adaptation of VLA models is hard because sparse rewards weakly supervise high-dimensional autoregressive action policies, and text-based privileged teachers do not transfer to low-level actions.
papers.q2: The VLA rolls out online and a proximal teacher is built in action space by perturbing its own action-token logits with calibrated advantage estimates, turning sparse rewards into dense token-level distillation targets.
papers.q3: Seven simulated robotic manipulation environments with in-distribution and out-of-distribution shifts, compared against PPO.
papers.q4: Experiments are simulation-only, and the teacher derives from reward-based advantage estimates, so quality depends on critic calibration.
papers.q1_zh: VLA 模型的在线适应很困难：稀疏奖励对高维自回归动作策略的监督很弱，而基于文本的特权教师难以迁移到底层动作。
papers.q2_zh: VLA 在线 rollout，并在动作空间构造近端教师：用校准后的优势估计扰动自身动作 token 的 logits，把稀疏奖励转化为稠密的 token 级蒸馏目标。
papers.q3_zh: 在七个包含分布内与分布外偏移的仿真机器人操作环境中与 PPO 比较。
papers.q4_zh: 实验仅在仿真中进行，教师来自基于奖励的优势估计，因此效果依赖 critic 的校准质量。

papers.title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation
papers.q1: Open-ended image generation increasingly needs an agent that combines a generator with search, references and tools, but image-level scalar rewards give weak guidance on how to improve such trajectories.
papers.q2: GenEvolve contrasts multiple tool-orchestrated trajectories per request and abstracts best-worst differences into structured visual experience given only to a privileged teacher branch; the student VLM agent is supervised token-by-token on its own sampled trajectories.
papers.q3: A Qwen3-VL-8B agent is trained on GenEvolve-Data and evaluated on GenEvolve-Bench and the public WISE benchmark.
papers.q4: The paper states no explicit limitations; the approach depends on the quality of retrieved experience and external tools, and the distillation targets the planning agent rather than the image generator itself.
papers.q1_zh: 开放式图像生成越来越需要智能体把生成模型与检索、参考图和工具结合起来，而图像级标量奖励难以指导轨迹如何改进。
papers.q2_zh: GenEvolve 对同一请求比较多条工具编排轨迹，将最优与最差的差异抽象为结构化视觉经验，仅提供给特权教师分支；学生 VLM 智能体在自己采样的轨迹上接受逐 token 监督。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 为智能体，在 GenEvolve-Data 上训练，并在 GenEvolve-Bench 与公开的 WISE 基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文未明确给出局限；方法依赖检索经验与外部工具的质量，且蒸馏对象是规划智能体而非图像生成器本身。

papers.title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.q1: Distilling strong black-box video teachers into causal autoregressive students is hard because only finished teacher videos are available, making fine-tuning off-policy and score-based distillation inapplicable.
papers.q2: AFD rolls out the current student on the same prompts as the teacher, trains a prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator, and converts the on-policy advantage into forward-process flow-matching updates on the student's own noised states.
papers.q3: Experiments cover two causal autoregressive student families, evaluated on motion- and physics-sensitive generation and general video quality.
papers.q4: The teacher supervises only indirectly through a learned discriminator on clean videos, so the signal quality depends on that discriminator; broader teachers and students remain to be tested.
papers.q1_zh: 把强大的黑盒视频教师蒸馏到因果自回归学生很困难：只能拿到教师生成的成品视频，监督微调是离策略的，基于分数的蒸馏也无法使用。
papers.q2_zh: AFD 让当前学生与教师在相同提示词上生成，训练按提示词配对的 Bradley-Terry 判别器，并把在策略优势转化为作用于学生自身加噪状态的前向流匹配更新。
papers.q3_zh: 在两类因果自回归学生模型上实验，评测运动与物理敏感的生成以及总体视频质量。
papers.q4_zh: 教师仅通过在干净视频上学习的判别器间接监督，信号质量依赖该判别器；更多教师与学生组合仍待验证。

papers.title: GeoStream: Toward Precise Camera Controlled Streaming Video Generation
papers.q1: Camera control in video world models is usually learned implicitly and fails on out-of-distribution trajectories, while explicit 3D caches built from the first frame break once the view leaves the initial frustum.
papers.q2: GeoStream keeps a self-refreshing 3D cache built from the model's own generated frames via depth estimation and reprojection; during distillation the conditioning is likewise rendered from the student's own outputs, so training matches inference-time errors.
papers.q3: Evaluated on camera-controlled autoregressive streaming video generation with quantitative and qualitative controllability comparisons.
papers.q4: The method relies on depth estimated from generated frames, so cache quality is bounded by the depth estimator and by generation quality over long horizons.
papers.q1_zh: 视频世界模型中的相机控制多为隐式学习，在分布外轨迹上不准确；而基于首帧构建的显式三维缓存在视角移出初始视锥后失效。
papers.q2_zh: GeoStream 用模型自己生成的帧经深度估计与重投影维护可自刷新的三维缓存；蒸馏时的条件同样由学生自身输出渲染得到，使训练与推理时的误差分布一致。
papers.q3_zh: 在相机可控的自回归流式视频生成上评测，给出可控性的定量与定性比较。
papers.q4_zh: 方法依赖对生成帧估计的深度，缓存质量受深度估计器和长时生成质量的限制。

papers.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
papers.q1: Post-training a diffusion model with separate RL objectives for text-to-image and editing yields specialized policies that must be merged into one model without losing either capability.
papers.q2: The pipeline builds VLM-based composite reward models, trains task-specific policies with a GRPO-based RL framework, then consolidates the T2I and editing teachers into one student via on-policy distillation with trajectory-level velocity matching.
papers.q3: Applied to Qwen-Image-2.0 and evaluated on Qwen-Image-Bench and text-to-image and image-edit arena Elo ratings.
papers.q4: No dedicated limitations section is given; results are reported on the authors' own benchmark and arenas, and most of the pipeline is RL rather than distillation.
papers.q1_zh: 对扩散模型分别以文生图和编辑的 RL 目标做后训练会得到各自专精的策略，需要在不损失能力的情况下合并为单一模型。
papers.q2_zh: 该流程先构建基于 VLM 的复合奖励模型，用基于 GRPO 的 RL 框架训练任务专精策略，最后通过轨迹级速度匹配的在策略蒸馏把文生图与编辑教师合并到一个学生中。
papers.q3_zh: 应用于 Qwen-Image-2.0，在 Qwen-Image-Bench 以及文生图、图像编辑竞技场 Elo 上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文没有专门的局限性章节；结果主要来自作者自建基准与竞技场，且流程主体是 RL 而非蒸馏。

papers.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
papers.q1: Few-step autoregressive video generators are fast but accumulate errors and lose motion dynamics over long rollouts.
papers.q2: OPSD-V has the student follow the exact inference rollout conditioned on its own generated KV cache, while a teacher evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states uses a cleaner cache with real-video history, giving dense corrective targets.
papers.q3: Applied to Self-Forcing and LongLive, evaluated with VBenchLong scores and a user study.
papers.q4: The authors note that cache construction and loss design are only one instantiation, and that more and better training video, compute, and stronger teacher-cache policies could help further.
papers.q1_zh: 少步自回归视频生成器速度快，但长时滚动生成时会累积误差并削弱运动动态。
papers.q2_zh: OPSD-V 让学生严格按推理流程滚动生成并以自身生成的 KV 缓存为条件；教师在学生访问到的相同去噪状态上评估，但使用含真实视频历史的更干净缓存，从而给出稠密的纠正目标。
papers.q3_zh: 应用于 Self-Forcing 与 LongLive，使用 VBenchLong 指标和用户研究评测。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出缓存构造与损失设计只是一种实现方式，更多更好的训练视频、算力以及更强的教师缓存策略可能带来进一步提升。

papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
papers.q1: On-policy distillation of diffusion models usually matches CFG-composed velocities, but how this behaves under classifier-free guidance is poorly understood and can hide compensating branch errors.
papers.q2: The paper identifies Negative Branch Asymmetry, where privileged information in the teacher's negative branch makes branch errors antagonistic, and proposes Positive-Direction Matching, which separately constrains the positive prediction and the CFG direction on student-generated trajectories.
papers.q3: Evaluated on dense-to-sparse video control distillation across inference guidance scales.
papers.q4: The analysis is demonstrated on one application (dense-to-sparse video control); generality to other CFG schemas and tasks remains to be verified.
papers.q1_zh: 扩散模型的在策略蒸馏通常直接匹配 CFG 合成后的速度，但其在无分类器引导下的行为缺乏理解，且可能掩盖相互抵消的分支误差。
papers.q2_zh: 论文指出“负分支不对称”现象：教师负分支含有学生不可得的特权信息时，两分支误差会相互对抗；并提出正向-方向匹配，在学生生成的轨迹上分别约束正分支预测与 CFG 条件方向。
papers.q3_zh: 在稠密到稀疏的视频控制蒸馏上、不同推理引导强度下评测。
papers.q4_zh: 分析仅在稠密到稀疏视频控制这一应用上验证，对其他 CFG 形式与任务的普适性仍待检验。

papers.title: FlowCTS: On-policy Continuous Trajectory Supervision of Flow Models
papers.q1: On-policy distillation helps LLM post-training with sparse rewards and exposure bias, but its extension to flow models is underexplored and vanilla KL-based OPD has a temporal supervision mismatch.
papers.q2: FlowCTS matches the subsequent student and reference trajectories initialized from the same student-visited state, deriving a temporally weighted velocity-matching upper bound discretized by the number of supervision steps.
papers.q3: Text-to-image experiments with multiple reference models report GenEval, OCR and PickScore, against KL-based OPD, a mixed-reward RL baseline and SFT.
papers.q4: Increasing the number of supervision steps trades richer trajectory information against harder optimization, so the step count needs tuning.
papers.q1_zh: 在策略蒸馏能缓解大语言模型后训练中的稀疏奖励与曝光偏差，但在流模型上的扩展研究不足，且基于 KL 的朴素 OPD 存在时间监督错配。
papers.q2_zh: FlowCTS 从同一个学生访问到的状态出发，匹配学生与参考模型后续的轨迹，推导出按时间加权的速度匹配上界，并按监督步数离散化为可用目标。
papers.q3_zh: 在多参考模型的文生图实验中报告 GenEval、OCR 和 PickScore，对比基于 KL 的 OPD、混合奖励 RL 基线和 SFT。
papers.q4_zh: 增加监督步数会在更丰富的轨迹信息与更高的优化难度之间权衡，步数需要调节。

papers.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
papers.q1: Scaling behaviour of text conditioning in visual generation has rarely been measured, and a generator trained on structured prompts needs a prompter that can produce them from short user requests.
papers.q2: The paper shows converged diffusion loss scales with structured language in prompts, then trains a prompter by SFT, cold-start and verifier-gated on-policy distillation: prompter rollouts that pass a verifier are supervised by a frozen teacher that also sees the reference image.
papers.q3: Evaluated on compositional, reasoning and world-knowledge text-to-image benchmarks against open- and closed-weight models.
papers.q4: The distilled student is a text-only prompter rather than the image generator, and the verifier cannot supervise visual details left unspecified by the request.
papers.q1_zh: 视觉生成中文本条件的规模化规律很少被度量；在结构化提示词上训练的生成器还需要一个能把简短用户请求扩写为结构化提示词的提示器。
papers.q2_zh: 论文发现收敛后的扩散损失随提示词中结构化语言的量而变化，并用 SFT、冷启动和验证器门控的在策略蒸馏训练提示器：通过验证器的提示器滚动结果由可额外看到参考图像的冻结教师监督。
papers.q3_zh: 在组合性、推理和世界知识类文生图基准上与开源和闭源模型比较。
papers.q4_zh: 被蒸馏的学生是纯文本提示器而非图像生成器，且验证器无法监督请求中未指明的视觉细节。

papers.title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
papers.q1: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences relies on sparse terminal rewards, which creates a severe credit-assignment problem across denoising steps.
papers.q2: Register tokens appended to a frozen DiT predict terminal preference from noisy latents, giving a dense differentiable reward field; RG-OPD turns it into per-step targets at states visited by the current generator, and RGS uses it for training-free guidance.
papers.q3: Compared with online RL baselines and training-free guidance baselines on preference-reward alignment, reporting pairwise accuracy and GPU hours.
papers.q4: The supervising signal is a learned latent reward model rather than a generative teacher, so results depend on the accuracy of the reward registers.
papers.q1_zh: 让扩散模型对齐人类偏好通常依赖稀疏的终端奖励，导致去噪各步之间严重的信用分配问题。
papers.q2_zh: 在冻结的 DiT 上附加寄存器 token，从带噪潜变量预测终端偏好，得到稠密可微的奖励场；RG-OPD 将其转化为当前生成器访问状态上的逐步目标，RGS 则用于免训练的采样引导。
papers.q3_zh: 在偏好奖励对齐任务上与在线 RL 基线和免训练引导基线比较，报告成对准确率与 GPU 时长。
papers.q4_zh: 监督信号来自学习到的潜空间奖励模型而非生成式教师，效果取决于奖励寄存器的准确性。

papers.title: Any-OPD: Heterogeneous On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Matching Models via Representation-Space Bridging
papers.q1: On-policy distillation normally assumes teacher and student share VAE latents, architecture and timestep grid, which fails when the best teacher and the desired student come from different model families.
papers.q2: Any-OPD treats the teacher as a black-box sampler that refines student-generated samples, compares decoded outputs in a frozen vision representation space, matches continuous noise levels instead of step indices, and adds a brief anchoring phase with re-encoded teacher samples.
papers.q3: Distils FLUX.1-dev into SD3.5-Medium, reporting PickScore and HPSv3.
papers.q4: The authors point to combining complementary teachers and extending to other latent generative modalities as future work.
papers.q1_zh: 在策略蒸馏通常假设教师与学生共享 VAE 潜空间、架构和时间步网格，当最佳教师与目标学生来自不同模型家族时该假设不成立。
papers.q2_zh: Any-OPD 把教师视为黑盒采样器来修正学生生成的样本，在冻结的视觉表征空间比较解码后的输出，用连续噪声水平而非步索引对齐轨迹，并加入用学生 VAE 重编码教师样本的短暂锚定阶段。
papers.q3_zh: 将 FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏到 SD3.5-Medium，报告 PickScore 与 HPSv3。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出结合互补的多个教师以及扩展到其他潜空间生成模态是未来方向。

papers.title: STEP-OPD: Rethinking Output Targets and Internal Dynamics in On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
papers.q1: Existing OPD for consolidating task-specialized image generators only matches the teacher's output velocity, capping the student at teacher level and leaving its internal representation evolution unconstrained.
papers.q2: STEP-OPD adds a scaled teacher-minus-base velocity difference to the teacher target so the student can go beyond the teacher, and aligns the direction and magnitude of block-wise representation changes between student and teacher.
papers.q3: Uses SD3.5-Medium with three task teachers, evaluated on compositional alignment (GenEval), text rendering (OCR) and human-preference metrics.
papers.q4: No explicit limitations are stated; the extrapolation scale is an extra hyperparameter and the method assumes teachers derived from a shared base model.
papers.q1_zh: 现有用于合并任务专精图像生成模型的 OPD 只匹配教师输出速度，使学生上限受制于教师，且内部表征演化缺乏约束。
papers.q2_zh: STEP-OPD 把教师与基座模型的速度差按比例加到教师目标上，使学生可超越教师；并对齐学生与教师逐模块表征变化的方向与幅度。
papers.q3_zh: 以 SD3.5-Medium 为基座并使用三个任务教师，在组合对齐（GenEval）、文字渲染（OCR）和人类偏好指标上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文未明确说明局限；外推系数是额外超参数，且方法假设各教师源自同一基座模型。

papers.title: Poly-OPD: Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability-Selectable Flow Models
papers.q1: Open text-to-image models have complementary strengths, but different autoencoders and noise schedules make it hard to transfer them into one compact model.
papers.q2: Poly-OPD re-encodes each student-generated image with a chosen teacher's encoder, refines it from a matched noise level, and matches the result to the student in frozen DINOv2 space, with shared attention LoRA, teacher-specific feed-forward adapters and a gap-aware curriculum.
papers.q3: Distils FLUX.1-dev and Z-Image into an SD3.5-Medium student, evaluated on GenEval and DrawBench HPSv3.
papers.q4: No explicit limitations are stated; capabilities remain teacher-specific and switchable via adapters, and only two teachers and one student are studied.
papers.q1_zh: 开源文生图模型各有所长，但自编码器和噪声调度不同，难以把这些长处迁移到一个紧凑模型中。
papers.q2_zh: Poly-OPD 把学生生成的图像用所选教师的编码器重编码，从匹配的噪声水平开始精修，并在冻结的 DINOv2 空间与学生对齐；同时采用共享注意力 LoRA、教师专属前馈适配器和按差距自适应的课程。
papers.q3_zh: 将 FLUX.1-dev 与 Z-Image 蒸馏到 SD3.5-Medium 学生，在 GenEval 和 DrawBench HPSv3 上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文未明确说明局限；各能力仍通过适配器按教师区分并切换，且只研究了两个教师和一个学生。

papers.title: InsertFuse: A Unified Framework for Multi-Category Reference-Guided Image Insertion
papers.q1: Reference-guided image insertion across many categories suffers from cross-category interference when a single model is trained jointly.
papers.q2: InsertFuse trains category-specific experts and consolidates them with Insertion OPD, querying the matched expert at student-visited states; it adds token-aligned geometry conditioning, region-balanced flow matching and Reference CFG whose enhanced supervision is distilled into the student.
papers.q3: Built on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with LoRA, evaluated on the AnyInsertion benchmark and a multi-category test set.
papers.q4: No explicit limitations are stated; reported experiments keep text prompts empty, so text-guided insertion is not covered.
papers.q1_zh: 多类别的参考图引导图像插入在单模型联合训练时会出现类别间干扰。
papers.q2_zh: InsertFuse 先训练各类别专家，再用插入在策略蒸馏在学生访问的状态上查询对应专家加以合并；并提出 token 对齐的几何条件、区域平衡流匹配和参考 CFG，将其增强的监督蒸馏进学生。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 并使用 LoRA，在 AnyInsertion 基准和多类别测试集上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文未明确说明局限；实验中文本提示词为空，未覆盖文本引导的插入。

papers.title: FlowErase-OPD: Multi-Concept Erasure via Anchored On-Policy Distillation in Flow Matching Models
papers.q1: Concept erasure methods for flow-matching text-to-image models mostly remove single concepts, and erasing many concepts at once while keeping generation quality is difficult.
papers.q2: FlowErase-OPD distils several single-concept erased teachers into one LoRA via on-policy distillation, adds a retention teacher as an anchor, and adaptively adjusts each teacher's sampling frequency and loss weight.
papers.q3: Experiments on nudity, object and artistic-style erasure with FLUX.1 Schnell, plus adversarial-attack robustness tests.
papers.q4: The authors report substantial compute and training time, possible interference from the anchor teacher, and evaluation limited to twelve concepts.
papers.q1_zh: 面向流匹配文生图模型的概念擦除方法多针对单一概念，同时擦除多个概念并保持生成质量很困难。
papers.q2_zh: FlowErase-OPD 通过在策略蒸馏把多个单概念擦除教师蒸馏进一个 LoRA，引入保留教师作为锚点，并自适应调整各教师的采样频率与损失权重。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 FLUX.1 Schnell 在裸露、物体和艺术风格擦除上实验，并测试对抗攻击鲁棒性。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出方法计算开销和训练时间较大，锚点教师可能带来干扰，且评测仅限十二个概念。

papers.title: DreOPD: Degraded-Reference Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation for Flow-matching Models
papers.q1: Post-training flow-matching models with RL gives high-variance gradients and cross-task interference, while conventional OPD is stable but only imitates the teacher.
papers.q2: DreOPD converts implicit reward extrapolation into a closed-form velocity regression on student rollouts, using a mildly degraded reference to sharpen the teacher-reference contrast and define the extrapolation direction.
papers.q3: Single- and multi-teacher image generation settings, compared with OPD and multi-task RL baselines.
papers.q4: Extrapolating beyond the teacher depends on the choice of degraded reference and extrapolation strength; validation is limited to image flow-matching models.
papers.q1_zh: 用 RL 对流匹配模型做后训练会带来高方差梯度和任务间干扰，而常规 OPD 虽稳定但只是模仿教师。
papers.q2_zh: DreOPD 把隐式的奖励外推转化为在学生滚动轨迹上的闭式速度回归，并用轻度退化的参考模型增强教师与参考的对比，从而确定外推方向。
papers.q3_zh: 在单教师与多教师图像生成设置下，与 OPD 和多任务 RL 基线比较。
papers.q4_zh: 超越教师的外推依赖退化参考与外推强度的选择；验证目前限于图像流匹配模型。

papers.title: HPSD: Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation for Text-Image-to-Video Diffusion Models
papers.q1: Unified text-image-to-video models generate better video when given a good first frame or detailed prompt, and internalizing that gain into plain text-to-video is hard: SFT is off-policy and on-policy distillation suffers condition-state mismatch.
papers.q2: HPSD uses one TI2V model as both teacher (high-quality first frame plus enhanced prompt) and student (vanilla prompt only); the student starts from off-policy teacher trajectory points, locally refines them toward its own policy, and receives velocity supervision on these rollouts.
papers.q3: Evaluated on text-to-video and text-image-to-video generation with TI2V diffusion models.
papers.q4: The scheme is hybrid rather than purely on-policy and depends on the quality of the privileged first frames and enhanced prompts.
papers.q1_zh: 统一的文本-图像到视频模型在给定高质量首帧或详细提示词时生成更好，但要把这种增益内化到纯文生视频很难：SFT 是离策略的，而在策略蒸馏存在条件与状态不匹配。
papers.q2_zh: HPSD 让同一个 TI2V 模型同时充当教师（高质量首帧加增强提示词）和学生（仅原始提示词）；学生以离策略的教师轨迹点为锚，向自身策略局部精修，并在这些滚动结果上接受速度级监督。
papers.q3_zh: 在 TI2V 扩散模型上评测文生视频与文本-图像到视频生成。
papers.q4_zh: 该方案是混合策略而非纯在策略，且依赖特权首帧与增强提示词的质量。

papers.title: Context-Matched Distillation: Teacher Causality for Autoregressive Video Distillation
papers.q1: Causal few-step video students are usually distilled with bidirectional teachers that score whole clips, so supervision can depend on future frames and controls the student never saw.
papers.q2: CMD uses a causal teacher that scores each target without future information and, via Prefix Scoring, under the cached student-generated prefix from the on-policy rollout; Prefix Corruption perturbs unreliable early prefixes.
papers.q3: Built on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, evaluated on VBench-I2V and on long-video and camera-controlled benchmarks.
papers.q4: Early student rollouts can be heavily drifted and need prefix corruption to stabilise training; the approach also requires training a causal teacher.
papers.q1_zh: 因果少步视频学生通常用对整段视频打分的双向教师来蒸馏，监督可能依赖学生生成时不可见的未来帧与控制信号。
papers.q2_zh: CMD 使用不访问未来信息的因果教师，并通过前缀打分在在策略滚动中缓存的学生生成前缀下评估每个目标；前缀扰动用于处理训练早期不可靠的前缀。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B，在 VBench-I2V 以及长视频和相机控制基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练早期的学生滚动结果可能严重漂移，需要前缀扰动来稳定训练；方法还需要额外训练因果教师。

papers.title: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.q1: Strong image generation and editing models rely on very large backbones and costly training, raising the question of how far a compact unified model can be pushed under a limited budget.
papers.q2: Swift-Image is a 6B single-stream DiT trained progressively; post-training runs parallel expert RL and then multi-teacher on-policy distillation to merge the experts, alongside a prompt enhancer, structural pruning and few-step distillation.
papers.q3: Covers text-to-image, single-image editing and multi-image editing, compared with open-source models, with 3B and few-step variants.
papers.q4: On-policy distillation is only one stage of a large engineering pipeline, so its individual contribution is hard to isolate from the report's overall results.
papers.q1_zh: 强大的图像生成与编辑模型依赖超大骨干和昂贵训练，紧凑的统一模型在有限预算下能达到什么水平仍是问题。
papers.q2_zh: Swift-Image 是渐进式训练的 6B 单流 DiT；后训练阶段先并行进行专家 RL，再用多教师在策略蒸馏合并各专家，并配合提示词增强器、结构化剪枝和少步蒸馏。
papers.q3_zh: 覆盖文生图、单图编辑和多图编辑，与开源模型比较，并给出 3B 与少步版本。
papers.q4_zh: 在策略蒸馏只是庞大工程流程中的一个阶段，其单独贡献难以从整体结果中分离。

papers.title: Beyond Attention Masks: Instruction Anchoring for Efficient In-Context Diffusion Generation
papers.q1: In-context diffusion transformers recompute reference tokens at every denoising step; decoupling them enables key-value reuse but stops references from attending to the instruction, hurting quality.
papers.q2: AnchorCache inserts static text anchors so cached reference representations are instruction-conditioned, then recovers quality with teacher-forced velocity distillation followed by a short on-policy stage that queries the teacher at student-visited states.
papers.q3: Benchmarks span image, speech and video generation, reporting quality parity with full attention and inference speedup.
papers.q4: Distillation is a recovery step for a structural conversion rather than the main contribution, and the speedup depends on the reference-context size.
papers.q1_zh: 上下文扩散 Transformer 在每个去噪步都要重复计算参考 token；将其解耦可复用键值缓存，但参考无法关注指令，导致质量下降。
papers.q2_zh: AnchorCache 插入静态文本锚点，使缓存的参考表征受指令调制；随后通过教师强制的速度蒸馏和一个在学生访问状态上查询教师的短暂在策略阶段恢复质量。
papers.q3_zh: 基准涵盖图像、语音和视频生成，报告与全注意力相当的质量和推理加速。
papers.q4_zh: 蒸馏是对结构改造的质量恢复步骤而非主要贡献，加速幅度取决于参考上下文的大小。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
papers.q1: RL can align diffusion models with preferences, but endpoint rewards do not say how an intermediate denoising prediction should change.
papers.q2: DiffusionOPSD lets a frozen EMA behavior policy generate trajectories that provide query states and anchors; reward gradients build bounded positive and negative clean-output targets around each anchor, which the trainable policy fits before the behavior policy is refreshed.
papers.q3: Experiments on SD 3.5-M and Z-Image-Turbo across ten reward evaluators, compared with methods such as DiffusionNFT.
papers.q4: The authors find larger target-construction gains do not always yield larger realized gains after one fitting update, and supervision relies on differentiable reward models.
papers.q1_zh: RL 可以让扩散模型对齐偏好，但终点奖励无法说明中间去噪预测应如何改变。
papers.q2_zh: DiffusionOPSD 由冻结的 EMA 行为策略生成轨迹，提供查询状态与锚点；用奖励梯度在锚点附近构造有界的正负干净输出目标，可训练策略拟合这些目标后再刷新行为策略。
papers.q3_zh: 在 SD 3.5-M 和 Z-Image-Turbo 上、跨十个奖励评估器实验，并与 DiffusionNFT 等方法比较。
papers.q4_zh: 作者发现更大的目标构造增益并不总能在单次拟合更新后转化为更大的实际增益，且监督依赖可微奖励模型。

papers.title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
papers.q1: OPD for flow-matching models needs a separately trained teacher per objective, which is costly, and teacher-student distribution gaps compound along the trajectory.
papers.q2: Self-OPD branches each step's next state into K stochastic SDE candidates, rolls them out with the ODE sampler, scores them against a deterministic self-reference, and pulls the velocity toward high-advantage branches while pushing away from low-advantage ones.
papers.q3: Uses SD3.5-Medium on single- and mixed-reward benchmarks covering OCR text rendering, GenEval and PickScore/HPSv2 preference.
papers.q4: There is no teacher model and the signal comes from reward models, so the method is closer to reward-driven RL; branching rollouts add training cost.
papers.q1_zh: 流匹配模型的 OPD 需要为每个目标单独训练教师，成本高，且师生分布差异会沿轨迹累积误差。
papers.q2_zh: Self-OPD 在每一步把下一状态分叉为 K 个随机 SDE 候选，用 ODE 采样器滚动到终点，与确定性的自参考基线比较奖励，并让速度场靠近高优势分支、远离低优势分支。
papers.q3_zh: 以 SD3.5-Medium 在单奖励与混合奖励基准上实验，涵盖 OCR 文字渲染、GenEval 以及 PickScore/HPSv2 偏好。
papers.q4_zh: 方法没有教师模型，信号来自奖励模型，更接近奖励驱动的 RL；分支滚动也增加了训练开销。

papers.title: OracleZoom: On-Policy Self-Distillation Inspired Reference-Constrained Recursive Image Super Resolution
papers.q1: Recursive super-resolution reaches extreme magnification by re-feeding predictions, but ground truth is unavailable at deep scales, leaving those predictions unsupervised.
papers.q2: OracleZoom trains on its own recursive trajectory, carrying the last ground-truth evidence beyond the supervision boundary via direct and cross-scale supervision, a no-reference quality objective, a KL-constrained pretrained latent prior and EMA consistency.
papers.q3: Built on SD3-medium with LoRA, trained on a 4KLSDB subset and evaluated on seven datasets including DIV2K, DIV8K, DRealSR, RealSR, FFHQ and Flickr2K.
papers.q4: Beyond 4x, exact recovery cannot be measured because ground truth is missing, so outputs may look plausible without being verifiable.
papers.q1_zh: 递归超分通过把预测结果反复送回模型实现极高倍率放大，但深层尺度缺少真值，导致这些预测无监督。
papers.q2_zh: OracleZoom 在自身的递归轨迹上训练，通过直接与跨尺度监督、无参考质量目标、KL 约束的预训练潜空间先验以及 EMA 一致性，把最后可得的真值证据带到监督边界之外。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 SD3-medium 与 LoRA，在 4KLSDB 子集上训练，并在 DIV2K、DIV8K、DRealSR、RealSR、FFHQ、Flickr2K 等七个数据集上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 超过 4 倍后因缺少真值无法衡量精确恢复，输出可能看似合理却无法验证。

papers.title: Flow3D-OPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for 3D Geometry Generation with Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer
papers.q1: Post-training for image-to-3D flow-matching models is largely unexplored: rewards for 3D geometric quality are hard to define and joint optimization of heterogeneous objectives causes gradient interference.
papers.q2: Flow3D-OPD first strengthens the base model and trains domain-specialized teachers with DPO guided by an agentic 3D verifier, then merges them into one student through on-policy distillation with hard task-routing sampling and gradient accumulation.
papers.q3: Built on Hunyuan3D-2.1, evaluated with pairwise geometric-quality assessment, ULIP and Uni3D metrics, LATTICE-Bench and a user study.
papers.q4: No explicit limitations are stated; teacher quality depends on the agentic verifier, and only geometry generation is addressed.
papers.q1_zh: 图像到三维流匹配模型的后训练研究很少：三维几何质量的奖励难以定义，且异构目标联合优化会产生梯度干扰。
papers.q2_zh: Flow3D-OPD 先增强基座模型，并在智能体式三维验证器指导下用 DPO 训练领域专精教师，再通过带硬任务路由采样和梯度累积的在策略蒸馏把它们合并到一个学生中。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 Hunyuan3D-2.1，使用成对几何质量评估、ULIP 与 Uni3D 指标、LATTICE-Bench 和用户研究评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文未明确说明局限；教师质量依赖智能体验证器，且只处理几何生成。

papers.title: CapField-OPD: Learning Continuous Capability Fields via Joint-Anchored Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow Models
papers.q1: Multi-teacher OPD for flow models routes each prompt to one teacher by semantic category, tying capability to prompt content, which is fragile to prompt changes and offers no user control over capability strength.
papers.q2: CapField-OPD uses teachers as anchors of a continuous capability field, where explicit coordinates determine how teacher outputs are combined into the supervision target; a small calibration set then selects default and candidate coordinates.
papers.q3: Evaluated on compositional generation, text rendering and visual aesthetics with flow-based text-to-image models.
papers.q4: Training anchors may not be optimal at inference, so an extra calibration step is needed to choose coordinates.
papers.q1_zh: 流模型的多教师 OPD 按语义类别把每个提示词路由到单一教师，使能力与提示词内容绑定，对提示词扰动脆弱，用户也无法调节能力强度。
papers.q2_zh: CapField-OPD 以各教师为锚点构建连续能力场，用显式能力坐标决定教师输出如何组合成监督目标；再用小型校准集选出默认坐标和候选坐标。
papers.q3_zh: 在流式文生图模型上评测组合生成、文字渲染和视觉美感。
papers.q4_zh: 训练锚点在推理时未必最优，因此需要额外的校准步骤来选择坐标。

papers.title: From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models
papers.q1: OPD for video diffusion needs specialized video teachers that are expensive to train and query, while cheaper image experts live in different latent spaces and provide no motion supervision.
papers.q2: MILD aligns student latent states and predicted updates with image experts through a learnable linear connector, constrains corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to keep dynamics, and adds an optical-flow-based motion reward.
papers.q3: Tested with several specialized image experts (e.g. aesthetics, OCR) and multiple video student backbones against video-teacher OPD baselines.
papers.q4: Image teachers suit largely temporal-agnostic capabilities; motion is preserved through constraints and a reward rather than taught by the teacher.
papers.q1_zh: 视频扩散的 OPD 需要训练和查询成本都很高的专精视频教师，而更便宜的图像专家处于不同潜空间，也无法提供运动监督。
papers.q2_zh: MILD 通过可学习的线性连接器把学生的潜状态与预测更新对齐到图像专家，将修正约束在预训练学生预测附近以保持动态，并加入基于光流的运动奖励。
papers.q3_zh: 使用多个专精图像专家（如美学、OCR）和多种视频学生骨干，与视频教师 OPD 基线比较。
papers.q4_zh: 图像教师适合基本与时间无关的能力；运动是靠约束与奖励保持的，而不是由教师传授。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.q1: Instruction-based editing models degrade quickly over recursive multi-turn editing because they are trained on clean sources but must condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference.
papers.q2: MT-OPSD trains the model on self-generated conditioning states while a teacher conditioned on the clean image provides editing supervision, needing no multi-turn annotations; the paper also introduces LME-Bench.
papers.q3: Three editing backbones are evaluated on LME-Bench (100 ten-turn sessions) and on single-turn editing quality.
papers.q4: Single-turn quality is largely but not entirely preserved, and the benchmark is small at 100 sessions.
papers.q1_zh: 基于指令的编辑模型在递归多轮编辑中迅速退化，因为训练时用干净源图，推理时却要以自己不完美的输出为条件。
papers.q2_zh: MT-OPSD 在模型自生成的条件状态上训练，由以干净图像为条件的教师提供编辑监督，无需多轮标注；论文还提出 LME-Bench。
papers.q3_zh: 在 LME-Bench（100 个十轮编辑会话）和单轮编辑质量上评测三个编辑骨干模型。
papers.q4_zh: 单轮质量大体保持但并非完全无损，且基准规模较小，仅 100 个会话。

papers.title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
papers.q1: Reward-weighted post-training of video models assumes all data categories induce compatible updates, which breaks when categories correspond to different skills or evaluation dimensions.
papers.q2: G3-LoRA probes category-level gradients, removes the shared direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and merges them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts.
papers.q3: Experiments on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and CogVideoX-2B with VBench2.0 dimensions and an independent evaluator.
papers.q4: Gains are not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation only partly recovers them, and camera motion and some local-quality dimensions remain hard.
papers.q1_zh: 视频模型的奖励加权后训练通常假设各类数据带来的更新相容，但当类别对应不同技能或评测维度时该假设不成立。
papers.q2_zh: G3-LoRA 探测类别级梯度，去除共享方向后按残差梯度相容性聚类，训练分组 LoRA 专家，再通过权重合并加上来自专家的在策略蒸馏合并为单一适配器。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 CogVideoX-2B 上实验，使用 VBench2.0 维度和独立评估器。
papers.q4_zh: 增益并不均匀：合并会压缩最大的专家增益，蒸馏只能部分恢复，相机运动和若干局部质量维度仍然困难。

papers.title: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
papers.q1: Real-time streaming video generation and interactive world models need few-step causal generators, and how best to combine teacher-forcing and self-forcing distillation is unclear.
papers.q2: Causal-rCM pairs offline teacher-forcing consistency models (including continuous-time variants via a custom JVP kernel) as initialization with self-forcing DMD, where the student rolls out chunks with KV caching and teacher and fake-score networks supervise its samples.
papers.q3: Distils Wan2.1-1.3B into 1-2 step causal models evaluated on VBench-T2V, and applies the recipe to the Cosmos 3 world model.
papers.q4: Training uses only synthetic data; the on-policy self-forcing stage is one half of the recipe, with the teacher-forcing stage being offline.
papers.q1_zh: 实时流式视频生成与交互式世界模型需要少步因果生成器，而教师强制与自强制蒸馏如何最佳结合尚不清楚。
papers.q2_zh: Causal-rCM 以离线的教师强制一致性模型（含借助自定义 JVP 内核实现的连续时间版本）作初始化，再进行自强制 DMD：学生借助 KV 缓存逐块滚动生成，由教师与 fake-score 网络监督其样本。
papers.q3_zh: 将 Wan2.1-1.3B 蒸馏为 1-2 步因果模型并在 VBench-T2V 上评测，还应用于 Cosmos 3 世界模型。
papers.q4_zh: 训练仅使用合成数据；在策略的自强制阶段只是方案的一半，教师强制阶段是离线的。

papers.title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
papers.q1: Translating text inside e-commerce images requires accurate translation, faithful visual identity and editable outputs, which existing methods struggle to deliver together.
papers.q2: TransAnyText has a VLM generate renderable HTML patches while a diffusion model inpaints the background; training runs SFT, then privilege-gap weighted self-distillation where a teacher given source-language HTML supervises the image-only student's own rollouts, then RLVR.
papers.q3: Uses Qwen3.5-9B and FLUX.2-klein-9B, with the multilingual TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench.
papers.q4: HTML/CSS rendering has limited expressiveness for curved or highly stylized text, which optional diffusion refinement only partly addresses.
papers.q1_zh: 电商图片中的文字翻译需要同时做到翻译准确、视觉风格保真和结果可编辑，现有方法难以兼顾。
papers.q2_zh: TransAnyText 让 VLM 生成可渲染的 HTML 补丁，由扩散模型修复背景；训练依次为 SFT、特权差距加权自蒸馏（获得源语言 HTML 的教师监督仅看图像的学生自身的滚动输出）和 RLVR。
papers.q3_zh: 使用 Qwen3.5-9B 与 FLUX.2-klein-9B，并构建多语言的 TransAnyDataset 和 TransAnyBench。
papers.q4_zh: HTML/CSS 渲染对弯曲或高度风格化文字的表现力有限，可选的扩散精修只能部分弥补。

papers.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
papers.q1: Hour-level video understanding suffers from ultra-long contexts, redundancy and high compute cost, and aligning many tasks in one model causes catastrophic forgetting.
papers.q2: Keye-VL-2.0 adapts DeepSeek Sparse Attention to a MoE multimodal model with 256K context, and uses cross-modal multi-teacher on-policy distillation: teachers give dense token-level feedback on the student's own rollouts, paired with Context-RL and Video-RL.
papers.q3: Evaluated on video understanding, temporal grounding, reasoning, STEM and agent benchmarks, including TimeLens, Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench.
papers.q4: As a technical report, the individual contribution of the distillation stage versus the RL stages and architecture changes is hard to isolate, and the pipeline depends on several expert teachers.
papers.q1_zh: 小时级视频理解面临超长上下文、信息冗余和高计算开销，而在单一模型中对齐多任务又会引发灾难性遗忘。
papers.q2_zh: Keye-VL-2.0 将 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力适配到 MoE 多模态架构以支持 256K 上下文，并采用跨模态多教师在线策略蒸馏：教师在学生自身 rollout 上给出稠密 token 级反馈，同时配合 Context-RL 与 Video-RL。
papers.q3_zh: 在视频理解、时序定位、推理、STEM 与智能体基准上评测，包括 TimeLens、Video-MME-v2 和 LongVideoBench。
papers.q4_zh: 作为技术报告，蒸馏阶段相对 RL 阶段和架构改动的独立贡献难以分离，且流程依赖多个专家教师。

papers.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.q1: Directly extending on-policy self-distillation to MLLMs creates a shortcut: the privileged teacher may guide tokens from the text reference answer rather than from the image.
papers.q2: ViGOS has the student first write a visual description and then reason; on valid rollouts an image-only perception teacher supervises the description and a privileged reasoning teacher supervises reasoning and answer on the same student prefix, with a reference teacher only for invalid rollouts.
papers.q3: Evaluated on general vision-language, expert reasoning, visual math, spatial grounding and visual-language-prior benchmarks.
papers.q4: The approach requires a fixed describe-then-reason output format and several teacher passes per rollout, which adds training cost; broader validation across model families remains open.
papers.q1_zh: 将在线策略自蒸馏直接扩展到 MLLM 会产生捷径：特权教师可能依据文本参考答案而非图像来引导 token。
papers.q2_zh: ViGOS 让学生先写视觉描述再推理；对有效 rollout，仅见图像的感知教师监督描述，特权推理教师在同一学生前缀上监督推理与答案，参考教师仅用于无效 rollout 以恢复格式。
papers.q3_zh: 在通用视觉语言、专家推理、视觉数学、空间定位和视觉-语言先验等基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 方法依赖固定的“先描述后推理”输出格式，且每条 rollout 需多次教师前向，训练开销增加；在更多模型家族上的验证仍待开展。

papers.title: Visual-OPSD: Cross-Modal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Unified Multimodal Reasoning
papers.q1: Unified multimodal models that generate intermediate visual thoughts pay roughly an order of magnitude more inference cost through diffusion, yet the rendered images bring little direct accuracy benefit.
papers.q2: Visual-OPSD shares weights between teacher and student: the teacher is conditioned on privileged visual-thought traces while the student sees only image and question, and token-level JSD on the student's own trajectories transfers the reasoning to a text-only output path.
papers.q3: Built on ThinkMorph and evaluated on nine benchmarks including VSP, with a Gaussian-noise visual-thought control.
papers.q4: The study is centred on one unified model (ThinkMorph), and distillation closes only part of the measured KL gap to the privileged teacher.
papers.q1_zh: 会生成中间“视觉思维”的统一多模态模型因扩散过程付出约一个数量级的推理开销，而渲染出的图像对准确率的直接帮助有限。
papers.q2_zh: Visual-OPSD 中师生共享权重：教师以特权视觉思维轨迹为条件，学生只看图像和问题，在学生自身轨迹上做 token 级 JSD 蒸馏，把推理能力迁移到纯文本输出路径。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 ThinkMorph，在包括 VSP 在内的九个基准上评测，并设置高斯噪声视觉思维对照。
papers.q4_zh: 研究集中于单一统一模型（ThinkMorph），且蒸馏只弥合了与特权教师之间部分 KL 差距。

papers.title: V-Zero: Answer-Label-Free On-Policy Distillation with Contrastive Evidence Gating for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
papers.q1: Fine-grained visual reasoning methods rely on RL with verifiable rewards or SFT on annotated traces, which means costly exploration, hand-made verification rules, or heavy textual supervision.
papers.q2: V-Zero views OPD as negative-free stop-gradient alignment lacking trajectory-level discrimination, and adds contrastive evidence gating: a question-relevant crop and a negative visual view are used to score student-sampled trajectories and gate dense token-level distillation, without answer labels.
papers.q3: Uses a Qwen3.5-4B student with a Qwen3.5-27B teacher, evaluated on V*, HR-Bench 4K/8K, ZoomBench, MME-RealWorld and MMStar.
papers.q4: Training needs paired positive-crop and negative visual views for each sample, so it depends on the availability and quality of region-level evidence.
papers.q1_zh: 细粒度视觉推理方法依赖可验证奖励的强化学习或带标注轨迹的监督微调，带来高昂探索成本、人工验证规则或对文本监督的重度依赖。
papers.q2_zh: V-Zero 将 OPD 视为缺乏轨迹级判别的无负样本停梯度对齐，并引入对比证据门控：用与问题相关的区域裁剪和负视觉视图评估学生采样的轨迹，从而门控稠密 token 级蒸馏，且不使用答案标签。
papers.q3_zh: 学生为 Qwen3.5-4B、教师为 Qwen3.5-27B，在 V*、HR-Bench 4K/8K、ZoomBench、MME-RealWorld 和 MMStar 上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练需要为每个样本构造正向裁剪与负向视觉视图，因此依赖区域级证据的可得性与质量。

papers.title: H-OPD: Confidence Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal On-policy Distillation
papers.q1: Multimodal OPD usually routes each sample to a single teacher by modality or task, ignoring that visual grounding and abstract reasoning dominate different decoding steps.
papers.q2: H-OPD performs token-level arbitration among heterogeneous teachers on the shared student trajectory: text-only teachers receive visual semantics via vision-to-language description transfer, and a confidence-aware mechanism combines the vision-language and text-only teachers at every token.
papers.q3: Evaluated on 11 widely used reasoning benchmarks.
papers.q4: Querying several teachers per token increases training cost, and text-only teachers depend on the quality of the transferred image descriptions.
papers.q1_zh: 多模态 OPD 通常按模态或任务把每个样本固定分配给单一教师，忽视了视觉定位与抽象推理在不同解码步上各占主导。
papers.q2_zh: H-OPD 在共享的学生轨迹上对异构教师做 token 级仲裁：通过视觉到语言的描述迁移让纯文本教师获得视觉语义，并用置信度感知机制在每个 token 上融合视觉语言教师与纯文本教师。
papers.q3_zh: 在 11 个常用推理基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 每个 token 需查询多个教师，训练开销增加，且纯文本教师依赖所迁移图像描述的质量。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Adaptive Inter-layer Composition for Efficient Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models
papers.q1: Heterogeneous VLMs that interleave efficient operators are faster, but existing designs use handcrafted static mixing patterns that are sub-optimal and hard to adapt to specific hardware.
papers.q2: MOSAIC searches layer-wise operator composition as a multi-objective mixed integer program under latency constraints, then recovers parameters with off-policy distillation followed by dual-teacher on-policy distillation: the original 4B teacher scores student-generated responses while a 235B oracle supplies higher-quality knowledge.
papers.q3: Validated as MOSAIC-4B derived from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on multiple benchmarks, reporting prefilling and decoding speedups.
papers.q4: Results are shown for a single base model, and the recovery stage relies on access to a very large oracle teacher.
papers.q1_zh: 交错使用高效算子的异构 VLM 速度更快，但现有设计依赖手工的静态混合模式，既非最优也难以适配具体硬件。
papers.q2_zh: MOSAIC 在延迟约束下把逐层算子组合建模为多目标混合整数规划进行搜索，随后先做离线策略蒸馏，再做双教师在线策略蒸馏来恢复参数：原 4B 教师对学生生成的回答打分，235B 教师提供更高质量的知识。
papers.q3_zh: 以源自 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 的 MOSAIC-4B 在多个基准上验证，并报告预填充与解码加速。
papers.q4_zh: 结果仅在单一基座模型上展示，且恢复阶段依赖超大规模的教师模型。

papers.title: Med-OPD: Improving Medical Vision-Language Models via Evidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Medical VLMs can give plausible answers from language priors instead of diagnosis-critical image regions, and uniform OPD lets abundant narrative tokens dilute the sparse evidence-dependent ones.
papers.q2: Med-OPD defines a Medical Evidence Advantage: the teacher, given an answer-aware hint, scores student-generated tokens under original versus evidence-degraded images, and this signal reweights distillation at token and trajectory level toward evidence-reliant content.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL-2B student with Qwen3-VL-4B teacher on OmniMedVQA subsets covering CT, MRI, disease diagnosis and lesion grading.
papers.q4: Experiments are limited to small OmniMedVQA subsets with accuracy as the metric, so broader clinical applicability is not established.
papers.q1_zh: 医学 VLM 可能凭语言先验而非诊断关键区域给出看似合理的答案，而均匀的 OPD 会让大量叙述性 token 稀释稀疏的证据相关 token。
papers.q2_zh: Med-OPD 定义医学证据优势：教师在答案提示下，对学生生成的 token 分别在原始图像与证据退化图像下打分，并据此在 token 和轨迹两级重加权蒸馏信号，突出依赖证据的内容。
papers.q3_zh: 学生为 Qwen3-VL-2B、教师为 Qwen3-VL-4B，在 OmniMedVQA 的 CT、MRI、疾病诊断和病灶分级子集上实验。
papers.q4_zh: 实验仅限于 OmniMedVQA 的小规模子集并以准确率为指标，尚未证明更广泛的临床适用性。

papers.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
papers.q1: End-to-end document parsing with a compact model has lagged behind pipeline methods on leaderboards, and applying RL directly to a very small model is unstable.
papers.q2: OvisOCR2 is trained with SFT, RL on a 4B branch with multi-component rewards, then on-policy distillation: the 0.8B student generates full page outputs and the RL-aligned 4B teacher supervises them with a reverse-KL objective, followed by model fusion.
papers.q3: Evaluated on OmniDocBench v1.6, PureDocBench and an in-house benchmark of long-tail document scenarios.
papers.q4: The report notes that robustness to degraded real-world images remains a direction for future work.
papers.q1_zh: 紧凑模型的端到端文档解析在榜单上一直落后于流水线方法，而对极小模型直接做强化学习并不稳定。
papers.q2_zh: OvisOCR2 依次进行监督微调、在 4B 分支上用多组分奖励做强化学习，再做在线策略蒸馏：0.8B 学生生成整页输出，由经 RL 对齐的 4B 教师以反向 KL 目标监督，最后进行模型融合。
papers.q3_zh: 在 OmniDocBench v1.6、PureDocBench 以及覆盖长尾场景的内部基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 报告指出，对退化的真实场景图像的鲁棒性仍是未来工作方向。

papers.title: MOPDA: Mixed-Trajectory On-Policy Distillation for Language-Guided Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.q1: LVLMs give interpretable image-level anomaly judgments for industrial inspection, but turning those judgments into precise pixel-level localization remains difficult.
papers.q2: MOPDA applies mixed-trajectory supervision, distilling token-level targets on both student-generated on-policy trajectories and evidence-conditioned teacher trajectories, and adds language-guided visual anchoring that uses the final judgment to build normal/abnormal anchors for anomaly maps.
papers.q3: Evaluated under a cross-dataset zero-shot protocol on five industrial anomaly detection benchmarks.
papers.q4: It is competitive with, rather than uniformly better than, CLIP-based methods, and mixing teacher trajectories makes the supervision only partly on-policy.
papers.q1_zh: LVLM 能为工业检测提供可解释的图像级异常判断，但把这些判断可靠地转化为精确的像素级定位仍然困难。
papers.q2_zh: MOPDA 采用混合轨迹监督，在学生生成的在线策略轨迹和以证据为条件的教师轨迹上共同做 token 级蒸馏，并提出语言引导的视觉锚定，用最终判断构建正常/异常锚点以生成异常图。
papers.q3_zh: 在五个工业异常检测基准上按跨数据集零样本协议评测。
papers.q4_zh: 与基于 CLIP 的方法相比是具有竞争力而非全面领先，且混入教师轨迹使监督只是部分在线策略。

papers.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
papers.q1: On-policy self-distillation needs teacher-student information asymmetry, which existing methods obtain from privileged answers or visual evidence annotations.
papers.q2: VCSD evaluates an EMA teacher at each student-generated prefix under the original image and a content-erased control; the token-wise log-probability difference sharpens the teacher's original-image distribution, which is distilled into the student as a full-distribution target.
papers.q3: Trained on ViRL39K with Qwen3-VL (2B/4B/8B) and Qwen3.5 models, reporting a seven-benchmark aggregate.
papers.q4: Two teacher passes per prefix add training cost, and evidence is limited to the Qwen model family.
papers.q1_zh: 在线策略自蒸馏需要师生之间的信息不对称，现有方法通过特权答案或视觉证据标注来获得。
papers.q2_zh: VCSD 在每个学生生成的前缀处，让 EMA 教师分别在原图和内容擦除的对照图下给出分布；用逐 token 对数概率差锐化教师的原图分布，并作为完整分布目标蒸馏给学生。
papers.q3_zh: 在 ViRL39K 上训练 Qwen3-VL（2B/4B/8B）和 Qwen3.5 模型，报告七个基准的综合结果。
papers.q4_zh: 每个前缀需要两次教师前向，训练开销增加，且证据仅限于 Qwen 系列模型。

papers.title: Self-Boosting Vision-Language Models with Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.q1: VLM post-training usually depends on human annotations, external teachers, or verifiable answers, which limits self-improvement without outside supervision.
papers.q2: NOPD trains the model on corrupted inputs while its own predictions under clean inputs serve as token-level supervision, turning the clean-versus-corrupted prediction discrepancy into a self-supervised on-policy distillation signal.
papers.q3: Tested on five visual reasoning tasks, including Geometry3K training with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and MathVista, and across three models on 12 benchmarks.
papers.q4: Without an external teacher or labels, gains are bounded by what the model already predicts correctly on clean inputs, and the choice of corruption may need tuning.
papers.q1_zh: VLM 的后训练通常依赖人工标注、外部教师或可验证答案，限制了在无外部监督下的自我提升。
papers.q2_zh: NOPD 让模型在被扰动的输入上学习，并以其自身在干净输入下的预测作为 token 级监督，把干净与扰动输入间的预测差异转化为自监督的在线策略蒸馏信号。
papers.q3_zh: 在五个视觉推理任务上测试，包括用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 Geometry3K 上训练及 MathVista，并在三个模型、12 个基准上验证。
papers.q4_zh: 由于没有外部教师或标签，提升受限于模型在干净输入下已有的正确预测，且扰动方式可能需要调节。

papers.title: RP-OPSD: Resolution-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.q1: OPSD for MLLMs often needs verified solution traces, externally generated explanations, or manually localized evidence, which limits scalability.
papers.q2: RP-OPSD lets the student generate on-policy trajectories from quarter-resolution images while the teacher scores the same trajectories with the original-resolution image, and minimizes the divergence between the two distributions using only image-question pairs.
papers.q3: Experiments on Qwen3.5-9B with fine-grained perception benchmarks (V*, HR-Bench 4K/8K, MME-RealWorld, VisualProbe) and MMVP, MMStar, POPE.
papers.q4: The benefit depends on tasks where resolution creates a real capability gap and on the downsampling factor; only Qwen3.5 models were tested.
papers.q1_zh: 面向 MLLM 的 OPSD 常需要经验证的解题轨迹、外部模型生成的解释或人工定位的证据，限制了可扩展性。
papers.q2_zh: RP-OPSD 让学生基于四分之一分辨率图像生成在线策略轨迹，教师用原分辨率图像对同一轨迹打分，并最小化两者分布间的散度，仅需图像-问题对。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上实验，使用细粒度感知基准（V*、HR-Bench 4K/8K、MME-RealWorld、VisualProbe）以及 MMVP、MMStar、POPE。
papers.q4_zh: 收益取决于分辨率确实造成能力差距的任务以及下采样倍率，且仅在 Qwen3.5 模型上测试。

papers.title: Veritas++: Value-aware On-Policy Distillation for Perception-Enhanced AIGI Detection
papers.q1: MLLM-based detectors of AI-generated images focus on organizing evidence for explanation while their underlying perception of fine-grained anomalies stays weak.
papers.q2: Veritas++ first strengthens perception with verifiable-reward learning (PoRL), then applies value-aware OPD: the student samples reasoning trajectories under the standard query and an EMA self-teacher conditioned on training-only labels and perceptual guidance gives token distributions, prioritizing high-value signals.
papers.q3: Evaluated on standard, in-the-wild and emerging AI-generated image detection benchmarks.
papers.q4: The authors note reliance on MLLM-based judging of reasoning quality, a focus on binary authenticity rather than localization or attribution, and inference cost unsuited to real-time use.
papers.q1_zh: 基于 MLLM 的 AI 生成图像检测器侧重于组织证据进行解释，而对细粒度异常的底层感知能力仍然薄弱。
papers.q2_zh: Veritas++ 先用可验证奖励学习（PoRL）增强感知，再进行价值感知 OPD：学生在标准提问下采样推理轨迹，以训练期标签和感知引导为条件的 EMA 自教师给出 token 分布，并优先利用高价值蒸馏信号。
papers.q3_zh: 在标准、真实场景和新兴的 AI 生成图像检测基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出：推理质量评估依赖 MLLM 评判，任务聚焦二分类真伪而非定位或溯源，且推理开销不适合实时部署。

papers.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: In multimodal OPD, the teacher's next-token corrections mix visual evidence with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects, so it is unclear which corrections are visually supported.
papers.q2: VAD evaluates a fixed teacher at each student-generated prefix with the relevant evidence present and removed, projects the teacher correction onto the resulting visual-evidence direction, and reconstructs a student-anchored target from the aligned component, keeping the privileged teacher as a weak regularizer.
papers.q3: Evaluated on six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B model scales.
papers.q4: The method needs identified evidence regions and extra counterfactual teacher passes, and the evidence direction is only a proxy for true visual attribution.
papers.q1_zh: 在多模态 OPD 中，教师的下一 token 修正混合了视觉证据、语言先验和教师特有效应，难以判断哪些修正真正由视觉支持。
papers.q2_zh: VAD 在每个学生生成的前缀处，让固定教师分别在保留和移除相关证据时打分，将教师修正投影到由此得到的视觉证据方向上，并用对齐分量重构以学生为锚的目标，特权教师仅作为弱正则。
papers.q3_zh: 在六个细粒度视觉基准上、4B 与 9B 两种规模下评测。
papers.q4_zh: 方法需要已知的证据区域和额外的反事实教师前向，且证据方向只是真实视觉归因的代理。

papers.title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners
papers.q1: In OPD for multimodal reasoners, trajectory-level outcomes cannot tell whether a wrong answer came from perception or from later reasoning, so perception errors are hard to target.
papers.q2: PCD rolls out the student with separated perception and reasoning, and multiplies downstream failure (1 - perception success rate) by teacher-student disagreement as a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation on correctable perception failures, using mean-preserving weights and no labels.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL 8B-to-2B and 32B-to-8B distillation trained on Geo3K, evaluated on eight benchmarks including MathVerse, MathVista, MATH-Vision, We-Math, LogicVista, MMMU-Pro and MMStar.
papers.q4: The authors acknowledge single-checkpoint results without multi-seed intervals, missing component-isolation ablations, and coverage of only one model family and training domain.
papers.q1_zh: 在多模态推理器的 OPD 中，轨迹级结果无法区分错误来自感知还是后续推理，因此难以针对性地纠正感知错误。
papers.q2_zh: PCD 让学生分离地进行感知与推理 rollout，并将下游失败（1 减感知成功率）与师生分歧相乘作为软与门，在可纠正的感知失败处加强蒸馏，采用保均值权重且无需标签。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Geo3K 上训练 Qwen3-VL 的 8B→2B 与 32B→8B 蒸馏，并在 MathVerse、MathVista、MATH-Vision、We-Math、LogicVista、MMMU-Pro、MMStar 等八个基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 作者承认结果基于单一检查点、缺少多种子区间和部分组件消融，且只覆盖一个模型家族和训练领域。

papers.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.q1: Standard OPD assumes the full teacher distribution is a suitable target, but teacher corrections may rely on visual distinctions a compact student cannot represent, which hurts downstream performance.
papers.q2: FP-OPD estimates the student's local visual tangent space with continuous visual perturbations, projects the teacher-student log-probability gap onto it under the student's Fisher metric, and optimizes full-vocabulary reverse KL to this realizable target on student-sampled trajectories.
papers.q3: 8B-to-2B vision-language distillation evaluated on seven multimodal benchmarks.
papers.q4: Estimating the tangent space through perturbations adds computation, and results are reported for a single teacher-student scale pair.
papers.q1_zh: 标准 OPD 假设完整的教师分布适合作为目标，但教师的修正可能依赖小型学生无法表示的视觉区分，从而损害下游性能。
papers.q2_zh: FP-OPD 用连续视觉扰动估计学生的局部视觉切空间，在学生的 Fisher 度量下将师生对数概率差投影到该空间，并在学生采样的轨迹上对这一可实现目标优化全词表反向 KL。
papers.q3_zh: 在 8B→2B 的视觉语言蒸馏设置下，于七个多模态基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 通过扰动估计切空间带来额外计算，且结果只在一组师生规模上报告。

papers.title: Same Semantics, Different Paths: Self-Improving Alignment for Vision-Text Compression
papers.q1: Vision-text compression renders long text into images, but a ViT pretrained on natural images captures glyphs and layout rather than semantics, so image-path and text-path representations diverge.
papers.q2: SPIRAL aligns the two paths without external teachers: the model generates responses from rendered-image input and its own text-input path provides token distributions on those prefixes for reverse-KL OPD, complemented by sequence-level preference optimization (DPO).
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL-8B evaluated on VTCBench and out-of-domain benchmarks.
papers.q4: The paper notes on-policy sampling makes OPD much more expensive per iteration than off-policy training, so it was not run at the largest data scale.
papers.q1_zh: 视觉文本压缩把长文本渲染为图像，但在自然图像上预训练的 ViT 捕捉的是字形和版式而非语义，导致图像路径与文本路径的表示出现偏离。
papers.q2_zh: SPIRAL 无需外部教师即可对齐两条路径：模型以渲染图像为输入生成回答，其自身的文本输入路径在这些前缀上给出 token 分布用于反向 KL 的 OPD，并辅以序列级偏好优化（DPO）。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 VTCBench 及域外基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 论文指出在线采样使 OPD 每次迭代的开销远高于离线方法，因此未在最大数据规模上运行。

papers.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
papers.q1: OPSD methods for MLLMs overlook modality imbalance: when text dominates generation the model under-uses its visual input, so carefully designed privileged information is wasted.
papers.q2: OPD-V builds a positive teacher from a zoom-in image and a negative teacher from a masked image; their logit margins define a modality-balance trust region that selects which on-policy student tokens are self-distilled.
papers.q3: Evaluated on 6 benchmarks with 4 MLLM backbones (Qwen3-VL-8B/4B, Qwen3.5-9B/4B) against 5 post-training methods.
papers.q4: Constructing zoom-in and masked views presupposes knowledge of the relevant image region, and two teacher views are needed per sample.
papers.q1_zh: 面向 MLLM 的 OPSD 方法忽视了模态失衡：当文本主导生成时模型未充分利用视觉输入，精心设计的特权信息因此被浪费。
papers.q2_zh: OPD-V 用放大图像构建正教师、用遮挡图像构建负教师；二者的 logit 间隔定义了模态平衡信任域，用来选择哪些在线策略学生 token 参与自蒸馏。
papers.q3_zh: 在 6 个基准、4 个 MLLM 骨干（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen3.5-9B/4B）上与 5 种后训练方法对比。
papers.q4_zh: 构造放大与遮挡视图需要预先知道相关图像区域，且每个样本需要两种教师视图。

papers.title: ADOPD: Reference-Privileged On-Policy Distillation for MLLM-Based Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.q1: MLLMs detect industrial anomalies better when comparing the query with reference images at inference, but this requires extra retrieval and processing.
papers.q2: ADOPD distills from a reference-aware teacher into a query-only student: the teacher evaluates student rollouts under matched and mismatched references, the matched teacher-to-student log-ratio gives the token-level direction, and the likelihood gap between references calibrates sequence-level weights.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL-4B backbone evaluated on the MMAD benchmark under zero-shot inference.
papers.q4: Training still requires normal reference images, and evaluation is reported on one benchmark and one backbone.
papers.q1_zh: MLLM 在推理时将待测图像与参考图像对比能更好地检测工业异常，但这需要额外的检索与处理。
papers.q2_zh: ADOPD 将带参考图的教师蒸馏到只看查询图的学生：教师在匹配与不匹配参考下评估学生 rollout，匹配参考下的师生对数比给出 token 级学习方向，两种参考间的似然差校准序列级权重。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为骨干，在 MMAD 基准上按零样本推理评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练阶段仍需要正常参考图像，且评测仅在一个基准和一个骨干上报告。

papers.title: Perception Before Supervision: Self-Contained Visual Distillation from Counterfactual Blind Spots
papers.q1: Reward-based self-improvement of MLLMs gives only coarse scalar feedback, while visual distillation usually needs external annotations, tools, or stronger models to build privileged context.
papers.q2: CVPD finds visual blind spots with a three-gate counterfactual criterion, regions where zooming in sharpens the answer but removal barely changes it, and uses the same model's crop-conditioned and blurred-region views as contrastive dense token-level supervision for the full-image student.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct compared with six self-evolving baselines on twelve benchmarks including OCRBench and MMStar.
papers.q4: Only a small share of candidate regions pass the criterion, gains concentrate on fine-grained perception, and evaluation is on Qwen3-VL models.
papers.q1_zh: 基于奖励的 MLLM 自我提升只提供粗粒度标量反馈，而视觉蒸馏通常需要外部标注、工具或更强模型来构造特权上下文。
papers.q2_zh: CVPD 用三重门控的反事实准则找出视觉盲区，即放大后答案更确定而移除后几乎无变化的区域，并用同一模型的裁剪视图和模糊视图作为对比式稠密 token 级监督来训练看全图的学生。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在包括 OCRBench、MMStar 在内的十二个基准上与六个自进化基线比较。
papers.q4_zh: 只有少部分候选区域能通过准则，收益集中在细粒度感知，且评测仅限于 Qwen3-VL 模型。

papers.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
papers.q1: Scientific discovery needs AI systems that reason over heterogeneous scientific modalities, use tools and environments, and sustain long-horizon tasks.
papers.q2: Intern-S2-Preview follows scientific multimodal pre-training with SFT, multi-task RL, agentic RL and on-policy distillation, where the student generates trajectories and a reasoning expert or agentic expert (both RL-trained) is chosen per query as teacher.
papers.q3: Evaluated on scientific, multimodal, agentic and general-purpose benchmarks, including SciTS and Biology-Instructions.
papers.q4: OPD is one stage of a large pipeline so its separate effect is hard to isolate, and the 397B scale makes reproduction costly.
papers.q1_zh: 科学发现需要能够对异构科学模态进行推理、调用工具与环境并支撑长程任务的 AI 系统。
papers.q2_zh: Intern-S2-Preview 在科学多模态预训练后，依次进行监督微调、多任务强化学习、智能体强化学习和在线策略蒸馏：学生生成轨迹，并按查询选择经 RL 训练的推理专家或智能体专家作为教师。
papers.q3_zh: 在科学、多模态、智能体和通用基准上评测，包括 SciTS 和 Biology-Instructions。
papers.q4_zh: OPD 只是大型流程中的一个阶段，其独立作用难以分离，且 397B 的规模使复现成本很高。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Visual OPD depends on teacher-student asymmetry from a stronger teacher or privileged supervision such as reference answers or ground-truth regions, which are not always available.
papers.q2: S2VOPD creates the asymmetry by removing information from the student: the teacher distribution conditioned on the original image is distilled on-policy into the student conditioned on a strongly augmented view, with a systematic study of augmentation families and strength.
papers.q3: Qwen3.5-4B evaluated on six fine-grained perception benchmarks.
papers.q4: Performance is sensitive to augmentation strength, and augmentations that remove question-relevant evidence produce uninformative discrepancies.
papers.q1_zh: 视觉 OPD 依赖来自更强教师或特权监督（如参考答案、真值区域）的师生不对称性，而这些并不总是可得。
papers.q2_zh: S2VOPD 通过削减学生的信息来制造不对称：把以原图为条件的教师分布在线策略地蒸馏到以强增强视图为条件的学生，并系统研究了增强类型与强度。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 在六个细粒度感知基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 性能对增强强度敏感，且移除问题相关证据的增强会产生无信息的差异。

papers.title: Accelerating Visual On-Policy Distillation with Batched Speculative Jacobi Rollouts
papers.q1: Visual OPD for compact autoregressive image models needs online student rollouts that are decoded token by token, adding large cost to every training step.
papers.q2: HB-SJD is a batched Speculative Jacobi Decoding backend for the student rollout: each image advances at its own pace while verification is batched, switching between Full and Compact execution, with teacher, distillation loss and optimizer unchanged.
papers.q3: Experiments with LlamaGen following the ImageNet class-conditional setup.
papers.q4: It is an efficiency contribution rather than a new distillation objective, tested on class-conditional generation with one model family, and switching thresholds depend on hardware.
papers.q1_zh: 面向紧凑自回归图像模型的视觉 OPD 需要逐 token 解码的在线学生 rollout，给每个训练步带来很大开销。
papers.q2_zh: HB-SJD 是用于学生 rollout 的批量化推测式 Jacobi 解码后端：每张图像按各自进度推进而验证仍成批进行，并在 Full 与 Compact 执行间切换，教师、蒸馏损失和优化过程保持不变。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 LlamaGen，沿用 ImageNet 类条件生成设置进行实验。
papers.q4_zh: 这是效率层面的贡献而非新的蒸馏目标，仅在单一模型家族的类条件生成上测试，且切换阈值依赖硬件。

papers.title: ArmorOCR: Grounded Adversarial Visual Perception via Observation-Transferred Self-Distillation
papers.q1: Large multimodal models read ordinary text well but fail on adversarial visual text that humans can still read, and existing benchmarks lack region-aware adversarial OCR evaluation.
papers.q2: The paper introduces the AdvSpot benchmark and ArmorOCR: the student samples responses from the original image while a self-teacher sees a transformed view plus adversarial-OCR priors and target text (OPSD), followed by GRPO with task-conditioned rewards.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone evaluated on AdvSpot (390 images, 13 adversarial types), other adversarial OCR benchmarks and general OCR benchmarks.
papers.q4: The authors note self-distillation is capped by the teacher's performance and that training relies on synthesized data.
papers.q1_zh: 大型多模态模型能很好地识别普通文本，却难以处理人类仍可读的对抗性视觉文本，且现有基准缺乏区域感知的对抗 OCR 评测。
papers.q2_zh: 论文提出 AdvSpot 基准与 ArmorOCR：学生基于原图采样回答，自教师则看到变换后的视图以及对抗 OCR 先验和目标文本（OPSD），随后用带任务条件奖励的 GRPO 进一步优化。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为骨干，在 AdvSpot（390 张图像、13 种对抗类型）、其他对抗 OCR 基准和通用 OCR 基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出自蒸馏受教师性能上限约束，且训练依赖合成数据。

papers.title: PailitaoGR: Latent Think-with-Images for Generative Image Retrieval
papers.q1: Generative image retrieval must generate product semantic IDs from cluttered query images containing the target, auxiliary evidence and irrelevant content, so the model has to focus on the right regions.
papers.q2: PailitaoGR adds target and auxiliary enhancers over visual tokens; the full-image student rolls out SID sequences while a teacher seeing only the cropped target region scores the same student prefixes, combined with attention guidance and contrastive distillation.
papers.q3: Evaluated on training and test sets sampled from real Pailitao image-search logs with a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone, reporting an average 13.8% gain over baselines.
papers.q4: Results are limited to one proprietary e-commerce search log and the paper states no explicit limitations; generality to other retrieval domains remains to be shown.
papers.q1_zh: 生成式图像检索需要从包含搜索目标、辅助证据和无关内容的杂乱查询图中生成商品语义ID，模型必须聚焦正确区域。
papers.q2_zh: PailitaoGR 在视觉 token 上引入目标增强器与辅助增强器；以全图为输入的学生自行生成 SID 序列，仅看到目标裁剪区域的教师在相同学生前缀上给出分布监督，并结合注意力引导与对比蒸馏。
papers.q3_zh: 在取自拍立淘真实图搜日志的训练/测试集上以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为骨干进行评测，平均超过基线 13.8%。
papers.q4_zh: 实验仅基于单一私有电商搜索日志，论文未明确讨论局限，向其他检索场景的泛化仍待验证。

papers.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
papers.q1: Autoregressive VLMs for structured perception suffer from compounding errors, and in on-policy distillation unreliable early student tokens can derail rollouts and weaken teacher supervision.
papers.q2: CA-OPD lets the student roll out while the teacher uses its own confidence to replace unreliable student tokens under a strict-to-relaxed schedule; corrected positions get cross-entropy targets and retained positions get the teacher's full distribution.
papers.q3: Multi-teacher distillation from two fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B experts into Qwen3.5-0.8B, evaluated on ScreenSpot-v2/Pro, OCRBench-v2, CC-OCR and OmniDocBench.
papers.q4: It relies on calibrated teacher probabilities, is validated only with shared tokenizers on structured prediction, and costs roughly 1.5x the wall-clock time of ungated OPD.
papers.q1_zh: 用于结构化感知的自回归 VLM 容易产生误差累积；在 on-policy 蒸馏中，训练早期不可靠的学生 token 会带偏轨迹并削弱教师监督质量。
papers.q2_zh: CA-OPD 让学生自行 rollout，教师依据自身置信度替换不可靠的学生 token，并按由严到松的日程逐步交还控制权；被纠正位置用交叉熵监督，保留位置用教师完整分布监督。
papers.q3_zh: 在多教师设定下将两个微调的 Qwen3.5-9B 专家蒸馏到 Qwen3.5-0.8B，在 ScreenSpot-v2/Pro、OCRBench-v2、CC-OCR、OmniDocBench 上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 方法依赖教师概率的良好校准，仅在共享分词器的结构化预测任务上验证，训练耗时约为无门控 OPD 的 1.5 倍。

papers.title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
papers.q1: Native unified models that both understand and generate images need stronger fidelity, text rendering and editing without losing generality, and separately optimised experts must be merged into one model.
papers.q2: SenseNova-U1.5 is an 8B encoder-free, VAE-free unified model; after post-training four experts, the student rolls out its own denoising trajectories and matches each frozen expert's velocity prediction at those student-generated states.
papers.q3: Evaluated on image generation, text rendering, infographic generation, multi-reference editing and interleaved generation at resolutions up to 4K.
papers.q4: The report notes that translation-related and reasoning-intensive edits remain comparatively difficult; the promised training code is still to be released.
papers.q1_zh: 原生统一模型需要在理解与生成两端同时提升画质、文字渲染和编辑能力而不损失通用性，并且要把分别优化的专家模型合并为一个模型。
papers.q2_zh: SenseNova-U1.5 是 8B 的无编码器、无 VAE 统一模型；在训练出四个专家后，学生沿自身去噪轨迹 rollout，并在这些学生生成的状态上对齐对应冻结专家的速度预测。
papers.q3_zh: 在图像生成、文字渲染、信息图生成、多参考编辑与图文交错生成上评测，支持最高 4K 原生分辨率。
papers.q4_zh: 报告指出翻译类与强推理类编辑仍较困难；承诺开源的训练代码尚待发布。

papers.title: OPD-Aha: From Linguistic Momentum to Visual Reflection in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: In privileged on-policy distillation, an early visual misreading in the student's prefix can drag the teacher into the same hallucination, so supervision vanishes exactly where correction is needed.
papers.q2: OPD-Aha scores student-generated trajectories with the same teacher under the real privileged image and a visual null, and builds the distillation target from this isolated visual preference, suppressing continuations that contradict the image.
papers.q3: Evaluated on fine-grained perception and complex multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with code and models released.
papers.q4: The approach needs extra teacher passes with a null visual input and depends on privileged visual evidence during training; behaviour beyond the tested benchmarks is open.
papers.q1_zh: 在特权 on-policy 蒸馏中，学生前缀里早期的视觉误读会把教师也带入同样的幻觉，使监督恰好在最需要纠正处失效。
papers.q2_zh: OPD-Aha 在学生生成的轨迹上，让同一教师分别以真实特权图像和视觉空输入打分，用由此分离出的视觉偏好重构蒸馏目标，抑制与图像矛盾的续写。
papers.q3_zh: 在细粒度感知与复杂多模态推理基准上评测，并开源了代码和模型。
papers.q4_zh: 方法需要额外的空视觉输入教师前向，且训练期依赖特权视觉证据；在所测基准之外的表现仍待研究。

papers.title: ReDraft, Don't Just Distill: Reference-Driven Revision for Continual VLLM Post-Training
papers.q1: Continual post-training of VLMs must learn new skills without forgetting: SFT learns from scratch but drifts far, while on-policy RL or self-distillation stays close yet gives little signal on unsolved tasks.
papers.q2: ReDraft has the model revise its own incorrect rollout using an expert response only as reference, keeps revisions accepted by a verifier, and fine-tunes with cross-entropy on them, so targets are explicit yet near the current policy.
papers.q3: Counting, Clock Reading and Jigsaw tasks on Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, compared against SFT and OPSD.
papers.q4: It assumes the model can revise its own output, needs an automatic verifier, adds a generation pass per failed rollout, and targets become stale as parameters change.
papers.q1_zh: VLM 的持续后训练需要在学习新能力的同时不遗忘：SFT 能从零学会任务但偏移大，on-policy 的 RL 或自蒸馏贴近原策略却在尚不会的任务上信号稀少。
papers.q2_zh: ReDraft 让模型仅以专家回答为参考修订自己的错误 rollout，保留通过验证器的修订结果并用交叉熵微调，使目标既明确又贴近当前策略。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B 上进行计数、读钟表和拼图任务实验，并与 SFT、OPSD 对比。
papers.q4_zh: 方法假设模型具备自我修订能力，需要自动验证器，每个失败 rollout 需额外一次生成，且目标会随参数更新而过时。

papers.title: BAS-OPD: Budget-Aware Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
papers.q1: Multimodal on-policy self-distillation transfers knowledge from informative views to full-image policies, but querying the teacher on every rollout makes supervision expensive.
papers.q2: BAS-OPD keeps full-batch student generation from full images but queries the privileged-view teacher only for selected rollouts, using random, uncertainty-based or learned utility selectors built from detached rollout statistics and agreement signals.
papers.q3: Evaluated on fine-grained multimodal perception benchmarks under constrained teacher-query budgets.
papers.q4: Selection quality depends on the utility estimates, and the study is confined to fine-grained perception; broader tasks and budgets remain to be explored.
papers.q1_zh: 多模态 on-policy 自蒸馏可把信息丰富视图的知识迁移到全图策略，但对每条 rollout 都查询教师使监督成本很高。
papers.q2_zh: BAS-OPD 保持学生对全图的整批生成，但只对被选中的 rollout 查询特权视图教师；选择策略包括随机、基于不确定性以及利用脱离梯度的 rollout 统计和一致性信号学习的效用选择器。
papers.q3_zh: 在受限教师查询预算下于细粒度多模态感知基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 选择效果依赖效用估计的质量，且研究局限于细粒度感知；更广泛的任务和预算设置仍待探索。

papers.title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
papers.q1: Diffusion VLMs answer by progressively unmasking tokens; prescribed masks ignore the model's own reveal order, while its trajectories contain provisional tokens that conflict with the target, and outcome-only RL gives weak contrast.
papers.q2: CT-OPD takes unresolved-position masks from the current student's reverse process, discards rollout values, and rebuilds each partial state from a completed teacher response, training the student with its native categorical loss.
papers.q3: Teacher Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct; students LLaDA-V, LaViDa-LLaDA, DiMoE-VL-Base and MMaDA-8B-MixCoT, on nine understanding benchmarks plus image-generation metrics.
papers.q4: Supervision comes from teacher endpoints rather than the student's own tokens, trajectories must be refreshed during training, and no explicit limitations are stated.
papers.q1_zh: 扩散式 VLM 通过逐步揭示掩码 token 生成答案；预设掩码不反映模型自身的揭示顺序，而其轨迹中的临时 token 又可能与目标冲突，仅有结果奖励的 RL 对比信号弱。
papers.q2_zh: CT-OPD 从当前学生的反向过程中提取未解析位置掩码，丢弃 rollout 中的临时取值，用完整的教师回答重构每个部分状态，并以学生原生的类别损失训练。
papers.q3_zh: 教师为 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct，学生包括 LLaDA-V、LaViDa-LLaDA、DiMoE-VL-Base 与 MMaDA-8B-MixCoT，在九个理解基准及图像生成指标上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 监督来自教师终点而非学生自身 token，训练中需不断刷新轨迹，论文未明确说明局限。

papers.title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
papers.q1: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding, but the teacher's crop advantage is hard to transfer to a student that sees the whole image.
papers.q2: PVD shifts the student's input from crop to padded crop to full image across stages while a crop-conditioned teacher supervises student rollouts, reweighting tokens by the teacher-student log-probability gap; PVD-full adds a policy-gradient reward loss.
papers.q3: Qwen3.5-4B evaluated on ZoomBench, HR-Bench, CV-Bench, MathVista, MathVerse, MMStar, MMMU and AI2D.
