papers.q4: Training uses only region-grounded perception questions on natural photographs (about 6K examples) and one backbone; no explicit limitations are stated.
papers.q1_zh: 区域到全局蒸馏利用裁剪条件下的引导提升全图理解，但教师基于裁剪的优势难以迁移到看全图的学生。
papers.q2_zh: PVD 让学生输入分阶段从裁剪图、保持比例的填充裁剪图过渡到全图，裁剪条件教师监督学生 rollout，并按师生对数概率差重加权 token；PVD-full 额外加入策略梯度奖励损失。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 在 ZoomBench、HR-Bench、CV-Bench、MathVista、MathVerse、MMStar、MMMU、AI2D 上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练仅使用自然图像上的区域感知问题（约 6K 样本）和单一骨干，论文未明确说明局限。

papers.title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
papers.q1: Replacing images with captions or code improves MLLM accuracy by 10.2%-23.6%, revealing a bottleneck between perception and reasoning in selecting the right visual evidence.
papers.q2: MM-OPD lets the image-conditioned student generate rollouts while a frozen self-teacher, additionally given the symbolic view (caption or code), supplies residual token-level targets on those trajectories.
papers.q3: Qwen3.5-4B and 9B evaluated on benchmarks covering perception, chart and document understanding, math reasoning and general VQA (e.g. MMStar, MathVista, ChartQA, DocVQA, OCRBench, V*).
papers.q4: Training requires symbolic views of each image, whose quality bounds the supervision; the paper states no explicit limitations.
papers.q1_zh: 把图像替换为其描述或代码表示可使 MLLM 准确率提升 10.2%-23.6%，说明在感知与推理之间存在选取正确视觉证据的瓶颈。
papers.q2_zh: MM-OPD 让以图像为条件的学生生成 rollout，额外获得符号视图（描述或代码）的冻结自教师在这些轨迹上提供残差式 token 级目标。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 上评测，覆盖感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理和通用 VQA（如 MMStar、MathVista、ChartQA、DocVQA、OCRBench、V*）。
papers.q4_zh: 训练需要为每张图像准备符号视图，其质量决定监督上限；论文未明确说明局限。

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
papers.q1: Visual token reduction speeds up MLLMs, but accuracy collapses at extremely low token budgets.
papers.q2: In LT-OPD the student generates responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same model gives distributional supervision along these trajectories, with a curriculum that gradually lowers the token budget.
papers.q3: Nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B at 5% token retention, with transfer to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B.
papers.q4: A performance gap to the full-token model remains at extreme budgets, and training requires extra teacher forward passes.
papers.q1_zh: 视觉 token 压缩可加速 MLLM，但在极低 token 预算下性能急剧下降。
papers.q2_zh: LT-OPD 中学生仅用少量视觉 token 生成回答，同一模型的冻结全 token 副本沿这些轨迹提供分布级监督，并采用逐步降低 token 预算的课程学习。
papers.q3_zh: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上以 5% token 保留率评测九个基准，并迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B 和 LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B。
papers.q4_zh: 在极端预算下与全 token 模型仍有差距，且训练需要额外的教师前向计算。

papers.title: K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings
papers.q1: General MLLMs struggle to read architecture, engineering and construction drawings, and reliable supervision for this domain is scarce.
papers.q2: K-OPSD samples N completions from the current model, keeps those certified by a process-level verifier, rescues failures by resampling with a hint exposing the verified answer, and trains on the verified completions with cross-entropy.
papers.q3: Qwen3-VL models fine-tuned on AECV-Bench, with out-of-domain transfer to ArchCAD.
papers.q4: The authors note small training and test sets, no statistical significance testing and limited verifier characterisation, calling the evidence preliminary.
papers.q1_zh: 通用 MLLM 难以读懂建筑、工程与施工（AEC）图纸，且该领域缺乏可靠监督。
papers.q2_zh: K-OPSD 从当前模型采样 N 个回答，保留通过过程级验证器的结果，对失败样本在暴露已验证答案的提示下重采样挽救，再用交叉熵在这些已验证回答上训练。
papers.q3_zh: 在 AECV-Bench 上微调 Qwen3-VL 模型，并在域外 ArchCAD 数据集上验证迁移。
papers.q4_zh: 作者指出训练与测试集规模很小、缺少显著性检验、验证器刻画有限，结论仅为初步证据。

papers.title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.q1: MLLMs doing reasoning segmentation improve when they can revisit their own earlier reasoning and localisation attempts, but this working memory is unavailable or costly at inference.
papers.q2: SWiM builds working memory from rollouts selected by segmentation quality; the memory-conditioned model gives token-level distributional supervision along trajectories generated by a student seeing only image and query, jointly with outcome-based RL.
papers.q3: Evaluated on reasoning segmentation benchmarks, where it reports state-of-the-art results.
papers.q4: The teacher's quality depends on the selected rollouts, and the study is limited to reasoning segmentation; the linked code repository is not yet accessible.
papers.q1_zh: 进行推理分割的 MLLM 在能够回看自己先前的推理与定位尝试时表现更好，但这种工作记忆在推理时不可用或代价高。
papers.q2_zh: SWiM 依据分割质量选择 rollout 构建工作记忆；以记忆为条件的模型沿仅看到图像和查询的学生所生成的轨迹提供 token 级分布监督，并与基于结果的强化学习联合优化。
papers.q3_zh: 在推理分割基准上评测，报告了最先进的结果。
papers.q4_zh: 教师质量取决于所选 rollout，研究仅限于推理分割；论文给出的代码仓库目前尚不可访问。

papers.title: Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
papers.q1: In crop-teacher multimodal OPSD, teacher corrections are contaminated by the lagged teacher's model-state gap and by context lost through cropping, so they are not driven purely by visual evidence.
papers.q2: EAD keeps the crop-conditioned teacher as target on student-generated trajectories, but weights each correction by its cosine alignment with a reference: the current student's prediction shift between evidence-masked and original images.
papers.q3: Evaluated on fine-grained visual understanding benchmarks against prior OPSD methods, retaining about 6% of dense OPSD's supervision mass.
papers.q4: It needs evidence-region annotations for cropping and masking plus extra student forward passes; applicability beyond fine-grained perception is untested.
papers.q1_zh: 在以裁剪图为教师条件的多模态 OPSD 中，教师修正会受到滞后教师的模型状态差异和裁剪造成的上下文丢失干扰，并非完全由视觉证据驱动。
papers.q2_zh: EAD 仍以裁剪条件教师为学生轨迹上的目标，但按每个修正与参考方向的余弦对齐度加权；该参考是当前学生在遮挡证据区域图像与原图之间的预测变化。
papers.q3_zh: 在细粒度视觉理解基准上与已有 OPSD 方法对比，仅保留稠密 OPSD 约 6% 的监督量。
papers.q4_zh: 方法需要证据区域标注用于裁剪和遮挡，并增加学生前向计算；在细粒度感知之外的适用性尚未验证。

papers.title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.q1: Aggressive training-free visual token pruning hurts reasoning VLMs; the paper shows much of the loss comes from unreliable use of surviving evidence, not only from lost information.
papers.q2: SCOPD has the student generate reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same prefixes; SCOPD+ distils selectively at visually sensitive positions found by a visual-budget intervention.
papers.q3: Evaluated across 13 benchmarks, several token budgets and pruning operators; at 10% retention, relative performance rises from 86.37% to 90.49% (SCOPD) and 92.43% (SCOPD+).
papers.q4: A gap to the unpruned model remains, and training needs full-context teacher passes; extension to other backbones and pruning schemes is left open.
papers.q1_zh: 激进的免训练视觉 token 剪枝会损害推理型 VLM；论文表明性能损失很大程度上来自对保留证据的利用不稳定，而不仅是信息丢失。
papers.q2_zh: SCOPD 让学生基于剪枝后的视觉 token 生成推理轨迹，拥有完整视觉上下文的特权教师在相同前缀上监督；SCOPD+ 通过视觉预算干预找出视觉敏感位置并选择性蒸馏。
papers.q3_zh: 在 13 个基准、多种 token 预算和剪枝算子上评测；10% 保留率下相对性能由 86.37% 提升到 90.49%（SCOPD）和 92.43%（SCOPD+）。
papers.q4_zh: 与未剪枝模型仍有差距，训练需要完整上下文教师的前向计算；向其他骨干和剪枝方案的扩展有待研究。

papers.title: KwaiMind Technical Report
papers.q1: Commercial image editing must preserve product identity, render text accurately and attract users, on top of general editing quality.
papers.q2: KwaiMind trains a multimodal diffusion transformer with pre-training, SFT, preference optimisation and online RL; reward-specialised teachers (CTR, text rendering, consistency) then supervise the student's own sampled denoising trajectories through a per-step mean-matching loss.
papers.q3: Evaluated on ImgEdit, GEdit, REDEdit and the new Ecom-Bench, plus an online A/B test of CTR-based main-image selection.
papers.q4: The report does not discuss limitations; the system is tailored to e-commerce editing and depends on domain-specific reward models.
papers.q1_zh: 商业图像编辑除通用编辑质量外，还需保持商品一致性、准确渲染文字并吸引用户。
papers.q2_zh: KwaiMind 基于多模态扩散 Transformer，依次进行继续预训练、SFT、偏好优化和在线强化学习；随后由各奖励专精的教师（CTR、文字渲染、一致性）通过逐步均值匹配损失监督学生自身采样的去噪轨迹。
papers.q3_zh: 在 ImgEdit、GEdit、REDEdit 和新提出的 Ecom-Bench 上评测，并进行了基于 CTR 选择商品主图的线上 A/B 实验。
papers.q4_zh: 报告未讨论局限；系统面向电商编辑场景，并依赖领域专用的奖励模型。

papers.title: Pistis Technical Report
papers.q1: Post-training multimodal models with distillation or RL alone, or with a static joint loss, leads to capability trade-offs and unstable optimisation, especially for long-horizon agentic trajectories.
papers.q2: Pistis applies large-scale SFT and then IDRL, which alternates OPD and RL phases in one loop: the student samples its own sequences and a larger frozen Pistis-27B teacher supervises them with a top-k Jensen-Shannon loss.
papers.q3: 27B and 9B models built on Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.5, evaluated on visual understanding, grounding and agentic benchmarks including multimodal search.
papers.q4: The report acknowledges remaining process-level weaknesses such as tool confirmation bias and loose coupling between retrieval and reasoning; no code is released.
papers.q1_zh: 仅用蒸馏或强化学习、或以静态联合损失对多模态模型做后训练，会带来能力此消彼长和优化不稳定，对长程智能体轨迹尤甚。
papers.q2_zh: Pistis 先做大规模 SFT，再采用 IDRL 在同一训练循环中交替进行 OPD 与 RL：学生采样自己的序列，更大的冻结 Pistis-27B 教师用 top-k Jensen-Shannon 损失进行监督。
papers.q3_zh: 基于 Qwen3.6 和 Qwen3.5 构建 27B 与 9B 模型，在视觉理解、定位及包含多模态搜索的智能体基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 报告承认仍存在过程层面的弱点，如工具确认偏差、检索与推理耦合松散；未开源代码。

papers.title: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
papers.q1: VLMs struggle to track state changes from object motion and viewpoint shifts and to integrate them over long trajectories, while existing spatial training mostly covers static questions.
papers.q2: Spatial-Interactor builds a three-level curriculum and the LSI-108K dataset; after SFT on local transitions, a teacher branch given segment-level transition descriptions supervises the student's on-policy chain-of-thought on long trajectories.
papers.q3: Multiple VLMs evaluated on spatial reasoning benchmarks, trained on LSI-108K from simulated and real interaction trajectories.
papers.q4: The privileged signal requires segment-level transition descriptions, and part of the data is simulated; closed-loop embodied deployment is not addressed.
papers.q1_zh: VLM 难以感知物体运动和视角变化带来的状态转移，也难以在长轨迹上整合这些变化，而现有空间训练多为静态问题。
papers.q2_zh: Spatial-Interactor 构建三级课程和 LSI-108K 数据集；在对局部转移做 SFT 之后，获得分段转移描述的教师分支监督学生在长轨迹上的 on-policy 思维链。
papers.q3_zh: 在多个 VLM 和多个空间推理基准上评测，训练数据 LSI-108K 来自仿真与真实交互轨迹。
papers.q4_zh: 特权信号需要分段级的转移描述，部分数据来自仿真；未涉及闭环具身部署。

papers.title: Reading is not Reasoning: Bridging the Agentic Policy Gap in Vision-Text Compression
papers.q1: Rendering agent interaction history as images cuts context cost, but visual-history agents drift in action selection, querying, stopping and evidence use, a gap not explained by OCR quality alone.
papers.q2: CAPS first distils successful text-history trajectories offline, then during RL the visual-history student rolls out while the same model's frozen text-history policy supplies full-vocabulary KL supervision on the student-visited states, added to the GRPO loss.
papers.q3: SearchQA and full-history ALFWorld with 3B and 7B backbones, compared against AgentOCR.
papers.q4: Results are sensitive to rendering choices, the offline stage depends on successful text-policy trajectories, and diagnostics rely on an LLM judge.
papers.q1_zh: 把智能体交互历史渲染成图像可降低上下文成本，但视觉历史智能体在动作选择、查询构造、停止和证据使用上出现偏移，这一差距无法仅由 OCR 质量解释。
papers.q2_zh: CAPS 先离线蒸馏文本历史策略的成功轨迹，再在强化学习阶段让视觉历史学生 rollout，由同一模型的冻结文本历史策略在学生访问的状态上提供全词表 KL 监督，并与 GRPO 损失相加。
papers.q3_zh: 在 SearchQA 和全历史 ALFWorld 上以 3B、7B 骨干评测，并与 AgentOCR 对比。
papers.q4_zh: 结果对渲染参数敏感，离线阶段依赖文本策略的成功轨迹，诊断分析依赖 LLM 评审。

papers.title: Reason What Matters: Retrieval-Grounded Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
papers.q1: CoT-enhanced universal multimodal embedding trained with GRPO retrieval rewards does not indicate which input-grounded evidence separates positives from hard negatives, and can produce redundant, slow reasoning.
papers.q2: ReWAM samples CoT rollouts and lets the same reasoner, conditioned on privileged contrastive evidence about positives and hard negatives, rescore them to give token-level weights on the policy update; a learned stopping criterion shortens reasoning at inference.
papers.q3: Evaluated on MMEB-V2 and MRMR with a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct reasoner, reporting up to 5x inference throughput over explicit-CoT methods.
papers.q4: Privileged evidence is extracted by a large external analyzer model, and CoT generation still adds autoregressive latency; code is not yet released.
papers.q1_zh: 以 GRPO 检索奖励训练的带思维链通用多模态嵌入，无法指出哪些基于输入的证据能区分正例与难负例，还可能产生冗余且耗时的推理。
papers.q2_zh: ReWAM 采样思维链 rollout，由同一推理模型在获得关于正例与难负例的特权对比证据后对其重新打分，为策略更新提供 token 级权重；并学习停止准则以在推理时缩短思维链。
papers.q3_zh: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为推理模型，在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 上评测，推理吞吐最高达显式思维链方法的 5 倍。
papers.q4_zh: 特权证据需由大型外部分析模型抽取，思维链生成仍带来自回归延迟；代码尚未公开。

papers.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.q1: Streaming video models must answer from a causally observed prefix, yet elaborate inference-time memory and retrieval modules barely beat a training-free sliding window, and RL with verifiable rewards encourages overly long think-then-answer outputs.
papers.q2: StreamOPD fixes a memory-free recent-window protocol and applies thinking-mode OPD: a larger teacher gives dense token-level supervision on student-sampled trajectories. ST-CueGate reweights OPD using cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios; a frozen copy of the initial student also works as self-teacher.
papers.q3: Evaluated on StreamingBench, OVO-Bench and Video-MME with a 9B teacher, deploying the student in instruct mode.
papers.q4: Larger-teacher OPD lowers hallucination-detection (abstention) scores, the cue gate is a coarse response-level weight, and a bigger 27B teacher did not help.
papers.q1_zh: 流式视频模型需仅凭已观察到的视频前缀作答，而复杂的推理期记忆与检索模块并不明显优于免训练的滑动窗口基线，带可验证奖励的RL又会诱导冗长的“先思考后回答”输出。
papers.q2_zh: StreamOPD固定无记忆的近期窗口协议，采用思考模式OPD：更大的教师在学生采样的轨迹上提供稠密的token级监督；ST-CueGate利用有/无线索的教师似然比对OPD重加权；以初始学生的冻结副本作自教师同样有效。
papers.q3_zh: 在StreamingBench、OVO-Bench和Video-MME上评测，教师为9B模型，学生以instruct模式部署。
papers.q4_zh: 使用更大教师的OPD会降低幻觉检测（拒答）得分，线索门控只是粗粒度的响应级权重，且27B教师并未带来更好效果。

papers.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
papers.q1: Video reasoning with large multimodal models is computationally expensive, and output-only OPD does not constrain the latent representations that accumulate evidence across frames.
papers.q2: Latent-OPD keeps token-level OPD on student-generated trajectories and adds hidden-state alignment at the end of each trajectory, with a progressive teacher-lookahead that maps middle-to-late student layers to increasingly deeper teacher layers.
papers.q3: Qwen3.5-9B/4B students with a Qwen3.5-27B teacher are tested on six benchmarks: VSI-Bench, Video-MMMU, MMVU, MVBench, TempCompass and Video-MME.
papers.q4: Gains shrink as the frame budget grows, and layer-wise alignment across different architectures remains difficult.
papers.q1_zh: 大型多模态模型做视频推理的计算开销很高，而仅在输出层监督的OPD无法约束跨帧累积证据的隐层表示。
papers.q2_zh: Latent-OPD保留在学生自生成轨迹上的token级OPD，并在每条轨迹末端位置加入隐状态对齐，同时采用渐进式教师前瞻策略，将学生中后层与逐渐更深的教师层对齐。
papers.q3_zh: 学生为Qwen3.5-9B/4B、教师为Qwen3.5-27B，在VSI-Bench、Video-MMMU、MMVU、MVBench、TempCompass和Video-MME六个基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 帧数预算增大时增益减小，且不同架构之间的逐层对齐仍然困难。

papers.title: Where to Look Matters: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Long-Video Understanding
papers.q1: In long videos the full-video context contains much question-irrelevant content that distracts VLMs, whereas feeding only short clue intervals gives better accuracy with fewer frames.
papers.q2: Clue-OPSD lets a full-video student roll out its own answers while a self-teacher conditioned on the annotated clue interval supplies next-token distributions along those trajectories, needing no answer labels and no clue annotations at inference.
papers.q3: Trained on 5,000 CG-Bench instances with Qwen3.5 models of several scales and evaluated on Video-MME, LVBench, LongVideoBench, MLVU and MMVU.
papers.q4: Training depends on annotated clue intervals, and performance degrades modestly when those intervals are imprecise.
papers.q1_zh: 长视频的全视频上下文包含大量与问题无关的内容，会干扰VLM；而只输入较短的线索片段能以更少帧获得更高准确率。
papers.q2_zh: Clue-OPSD让观看完整视频的学生自行生成回答，由以标注线索片段为条件的自教师沿这些轨迹提供下一token分布，训练无需答案标签，推理无需线索标注。
papers.q3_zh: 使用CG-Bench的5000条样本训练多种规模的Qwen3.5模型，并在Video-MME、LVBench、LongVideoBench、MLVU和MMVU上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练依赖标注的线索片段，片段不精确时性能会有一定下降。

papers.title: Video-OPSD: Exploiting Privileged Visual Evidence for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Video Large Language Models
papers.q1: OPSD is little explored for Video-LLMs, and existing privileged teachers add extra context rather than exploiting the fact that only a few frames of a long video carry the evidence.
papers.q2: The student reasons over the full video and rolls out its own response, while the self-teacher sees only annotated evidence frames; token-level distillation is further weighted by each token's reliance on that privileged visual evidence.
papers.q3: Tested with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-4B on Video-Holmes, Video-MMMU, Video-MME, TempCompass and WorldSense.
papers.q4: The approach needs evidence-interval annotations for training and was studied on a fairly small training set.
papers.q1_zh: OPSD在Video-LLM上探索不足，现有特权教师多靠附加上下文构造，未利用长视频中只有少数帧承载答案证据这一特点。
papers.q2_zh: 学生基于完整视频推理并生成自己的回答，自教师只看标注的证据帧；token级蒸馏再按各token对特权视觉证据的依赖程度加权。
papers.q3_zh: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3-VL-4B上，于Video-Holmes、Video-MMMU、Video-MME、TempCompass和WorldSense评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练需要证据片段标注，且仅在较小规模的训练集上验证。

papers.title: Video-MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Video Understanding
papers.q1: Video understanding needs perception, temporal grounding and complex reasoning together, and these abilities are hard to optimize jointly in one model.
papers.q2: Three RL-trained experts (temporal grounding, general comprehension, video STEM) act as teachers; the student samples trajectories that are supervised by the routed teacher, and RAIS selects examples with reliable teacher signal and large teacher-student gaps.
papers.q3: Video-MOPD-8B is evaluated on MVBench, MMVU, Video-MME, VideoMMMU, Video-Holmes, TimeLens and TempCompass.
papers.q4: Long-form videos with sparse, distant evidence are left to future work.
papers.q1_zh: 视频理解同时需要感知、时序定位与复杂推理，这些能力难以在单一模型中联合优化。
papers.q2_zh: 三个经RL训练的专家（时序定位、通用理解、视频STEM）作为教师；学生采样的轨迹由路由到的教师监督，RAIS挑选教师信号可靠且师生差距大的样本。
papers.q3_zh: Video-MOPD-8B在MVBench、MMVU、Video-MME、VideoMMMU、Video-Holmes、TimeLens和TempCompass上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 证据稀疏且相距较远的长视频留待未来工作。

papers.title: Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding
papers.q1: Temporal grounding in MLLMs is confused by repeated actions and similar contexts, and plain next-token OPD cannot tell which video segments support each predicted timestamp.
papers.q2: CAPD keeps teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories but masks each temporal group to measure the change in the teacher's output distribution; this counterfactual influence calibrates teacher attention and weights token-level distillation.
papers.q3: Trained on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with 2,500 samples for one epoch and evaluated on TimeLens plus general video benchmarks.
papers.q4: Temporal groups are fixed rather than event-adaptive, and the multiple teacher forward passes raise training cost.
papers.q1_zh: MLLM的时序定位易受重复动作和相似场景干扰，而普通的下一token OPD无法识别支撑每个预测时间戳的视频片段。
papers.q2_zh: CAPD保留教师对学生自生成轨迹的监督，同时逐一遮蔽各时间组并度量教师输出分布的变化；该反事实影响用于校准教师注意力并对token级蒸馏加权。
papers.q3_zh: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上仅用2500条样本训练一个epoch，并在TimeLens及通用视频基准上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 时间分组是固定的而非随事件自适应，多次教师前向也增加了训练开销。

papers.title: Temporal Self-Distillation: Learning Visual State Tracking in Videos Without Supervision
papers.q1: Continuous visual state tracking in videos is weak in current video models, and prior self-evolving methods leave it largely unchanged.
papers.q2: S3T treats temporal sampling density as privileged information: the sparse-frame student decodes its own answer and matches the next-token distribution of the same model given a denser view of the clip, with no labels, separate teacher or reward.
papers.q3: Applied to LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B and evaluated on VSTAT, VSTAT-YouTube and MVBench Action Count.
papers.q4: The method does not transfer consistently across backbones; only LLaVA-OV-2-8B improved clearly and the cause is unexplained.
papers.q1_zh: 现有视频模型在连续视觉状态跟踪上较弱，已有的自进化方法对此几乎没有改善。
papers.q2_zh: S3T把时间采样密度视为特权信息：稀疏帧学生解码出自己的答案，并匹配同一模型在更密集视图下的下一token分布，无需标签、独立教师或奖励。
papers.q3_zh: 应用于LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B，并在VSTAT、VSTAT-YouTube和MVBench Action Count上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 方法在不同骨干间迁移不稳定，仅LLaVA-OV-2-8B有明显提升，原因尚未解释。

papers.title: ParaBridge: Bridging Paralinguistic Perception and Dialogue Behavior in Speech Language Models
papers.q1: Speech language models can recognize paralinguistic cues such as age, emotion or background noise but often ignore them when replying, and inference-time prompt scaffolds are brittle.
papers.q2: The scaffold-free model rolls out its own response, and the same model given a paralinguistic instruction scaffold as privileged view provides dense full-vocabulary next-token targets along that trajectory, without curated dialogues, labels or reward models.
papers.q3: Trained on Qwen3-Omni-thinking and evaluated on VoxSafeBench, EchoMind, MMAU-Pro, VoiceBench and GPQA, plus another SLM backbone.
papers.q4: The teacher signal is bounded by what the scaffolded model already does well, so cues the base model cannot perceive are unlikely to be fixed.
papers.q1_zh: 语音语言模型能识别年龄、情绪、背景噪声等副语言线索，却常在回复中忽略它们，而推理期的提示脚手架又很脆弱。
papers.q2_zh: 无脚手架的模型自行生成回复，同一模型在带副语言指令脚手架的特权视图下沿该轨迹提供稠密的全词表下一token目标，无需人工对话、标签或奖励模型。
papers.q3_zh: 在Qwen3-Omni-thinking上训练，并于VoxSafeBench、EchoMind、MMAU-Pro、VoiceBench和GPQA及另一SLM骨干上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 教师信号受限于带脚手架模型自身的能力，基座模型感知不到的线索难以借此修复。

papers.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
papers.q1: Audio-language models perceive sound well but reason far worse than text LLMs, largely because high-quality audio reasoning data is scarce.
papers.q2: The audio student generates reasoning trajectories from its own acoustic perception, while a strong text teacher given matched textual inputs and verified answers provides token-level guidance; a three-tier corpus covers spoken text reasoning, audio-event reasoning and paralinguistic dialogue.
papers.q3: Evaluated on MMSU, MMAU, BIG Bench Audio and MMAR.
papers.q4: The teacher depends on faithful textual renderings of the audio, which is harder for non-linguistic and paralinguistic content.
papers.q1_zh: 音频语言模型感知能力强，但推理远逊于文本LLM，主要原因是高质量音频推理数据稀缺。
papers.q2_zh: 音频学生基于自身声学感知生成推理轨迹，强文本教师在获得匹配的文本输入与已验证答案后提供token级指导；三层语料覆盖语音化文本推理、音频事件推理和副语言对话推理。
papers.q3_zh: 在MMSU、MMAU、BIG Bench Audio和MMAR上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 教师依赖对音频的忠实文本化描述，这对非语言和副语言内容更为困难。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Dialect ASR: Mastering Dialects, Retaining Mandarin
papers.q1: Adapting a strong ASR model to Chinese dialects lowers dialect error but tends to raise Mandarin error.
papers.q2: After continual pre-training and dialect SFT, OPSD trains the student on its own decoded prefixes while a frozen teacher conditioned on the reference transcript supplies soft token-level targets, replacing hard cross-entropy updates.
papers.q3: Instantiated with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and evaluated on public and internal Mandarin and dialect test sets.
papers.q4: The privileged teacher still needs reference transcripts, and part of the evaluation relies on internal test sets.
papers.q1_zh: 将强ASR模型适配到汉语方言可降低方言错误率，却往往会抬高普通话错误率。
papers.q2_zh: 在持续预训练和方言SFT之后，OPSD让学生在自己解码出的前缀上训练，由以参考转写为特权条件的冻结教师提供软token级目标，取代硬交叉熵更新。
papers.q3_zh: 以Qwen3-ASR-1.7B实现，在公开及内部的普通话和方言测试集上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 特权教师仍需参考转写文本，且部分评测依赖内部测试集。

papers.title: Reducing the Output-Mode Gap in Speech Language Models via Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Speech LLMs that interleave text and acoustic tokens answer much less accurately in speech-output mode than in text-output mode for the same spoken input.
papers.q2: The student generates interleaved text-speech trajectories; at each text position the model's own speech-to-text policy, fed a text-only projection of the student's previous outputs, gives soft targets, with a preservation loss on non-text predictions.
papers.q3: Tested on Step-Audio-2-mini and Baichuan-Audio-Instruct with Spoken-MQA and speech-rendered GSM8K.
papers.q4: Trajectories come from the initial student, evaluation uses synthesized speech and ASR-based scoring, and gains vary across architectures.
papers.q1_zh: 文本与声学token交错生成的语音大模型，在同一语音输入下，语音输出模式的答案准确率远低于文本输出模式。
papers.q2_zh: 学生生成文本-语音交错轨迹；在每个文本位置，模型自身的语音到文本策略以学生此前输出的纯文本投影为输入给出软目标，并用保持损失约束非文本预测。
papers.q3_zh: 在Step-Audio-2-mini和Baichuan-Audio-Instruct上，用Spoken-MQA和语音化的GSM8K评测。
papers.q4_zh: 轨迹采样自初始学生，评测使用合成语音和基于ASR的打分，且不同架构上的增益不一。

papers.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: Towards Reliable Agentic Voice Interaction
papers.q1: Real-time voice assistants must reason over evolving requests, call tools and respect conversational rules, which a single audio model rarely does reliably.
papers.q2: In M2-OPD the audio student samples trajectories that are scored token by token by a text teacher and a frozen audio reference, then by audio-domain specialist teachers; GRPO in executable environments separately trains tool use.
papers.q3: Evaluated on audio reasoning, multilingual understanding, tool use, a tau-Voice adaptation, Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 and safety.
papers.q4: The report lacks controlled ablations isolating each training component and has limited real-recording and long-horizon task coverage.
papers.q1_zh: 实时语音助手需要对不断变化的请求进行推理、调用工具并遵守对话规则，单一音频模型很难稳定做到。
papers.q2_zh: 在M2-OPD中，音频学生采样轨迹，先由文本教师和冻结的音频参考模型逐token打分，再由各音频领域专家教师监督；工具使用则另由可执行环境中的GRPO训练。
papers.q3_zh: 在音频推理、多语言理解、工具使用、tau-Voice改编版、Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5和安全性上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 报告缺少分离各训练组件贡献的对照消融，真实录音和长程任务的覆盖也有限。

papers.title: Reward-Tilted On-Policy Distillation for Acoustic Grounding in Audio-Language Models
papers.q1: Audio-language models can answer through textual shortcuts while ignoring the audio, and vanilla OPD does not separate acoustic evidence from linguistic predictability.
papers.q2: On the student's generated text, a frozen teacher predicts the next token with and without audio; the log-probability contrast is a reward that tilts the teacher distribution used for reverse-KL distillation.
papers.q3: Ke-Omni-R-7B teaches Ke-Omni-R-3B and Qwen2.5-Omni-3B students, evaluated on MMAU, MMAR and ADQA.
papers.q4: Two teacher passes per step add training cost, and the study covers only audio question answering with a small training subset.
papers.q1_zh: 音频语言模型可能靠文本捷径作答而忽略音频，普通OPD无法区分声学证据与语言可预测性。
papers.q2_zh: 在学生生成的文本上，冻结教师分别在有音频和无音频条件下预测下一token；二者对数概率之差作为奖励，对用于反向KL蒸馏的教师分布进行倾斜。
papers.q3_zh: 以Ke-Omni-R-7B为教师，学生为Ke-Omni-R-3B和Qwen2.5-Omni-3B，在MMAU、MMAR和ADQA上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 每步需两次教师前向，增加训练开销，且研究仅覆盖音频问答并使用较小的训练子集。

papers.title: TS-OPD: Reconciling ASR and QA in Speech Language Models via Task-Specific On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Specializing a speech language model for ASR substantially degrades the instruction-following and QA ability inherited from the language model.
papers.q2: Checkpoints before and after ASR specialization serve as QA and ASR teachers; the student generates separate task-conditioned trajectories, each supervised only by its matching teacher to avoid conflicting signals.
papers.q3: Uses Whisper-large-v3 with Qwen3-4B, trained on Emilia and evaluated on LibriSpeech, GigaSpeech, ContextASR-Bench and TELEVAL QA sets.
papers.q4: Experiments are English-only with short utterances, so multilingual and long-form behaviour is untested.
papers.q1_zh: 将语音语言模型专门化用于ASR，会明显削弱其从语言模型继承的指令跟随与问答能力。
papers.q2_zh: ASR专门化前后的检查点分别作为问答教师和ASR教师；学生为两类任务分别生成任务条件轨迹，每条轨迹只由对应教师监督，以避免监督信号冲突。
papers.q3_zh: 采用Whisper-large-v3与Qwen3-4B，在Emilia上训练，并在LibriSpeech、GigaSpeech、ContextASR-Bench和TELEVAL问答集上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 实验仅限英语和短语音，多语言与长音频场景尚未验证。

papers.title: OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation
papers.q1: Post-training an omni model on pooled multimodal data fails to keep the strengths of modality specialists, and standard OPD handles conflicting teachers poorly and caps the student at the teacher.
papers.q2: The student samples responses that are routed to the matching text, image or audio teacher; guidance is applied only where the teacher gives the generated token higher probability, and the teacher also scores answer confidence and reasoning support.
papers.q3: Evaluated on twelve benchmarks at three model scales, including a 30B student.
papers.q4: Training requires a separate strong teacher per modality, and only the student is kept for deployment.
papers.q1_zh: 在混合多模态数据上对全模态模型做后训练难以保留各模态专家的优势，标准OPD既难处理教师间冲突，又会把学生限制在教师水平。
papers.q2_zh: 学生采样的回答被路由到对应的文本、图像或音频教师；仅当教师给所生成token更高概率时才施加引导，教师还评估答案置信度及推理对答案的支持。
papers.q3_zh: 在三种模型规模（含30B学生）上对十二个基准进行评测。
papers.q4_zh: 训练需要为每个模态准备一个强教师，部署时仅保留学生模型。

papers.title: EchoDistill:Alignment Noisy-to-Clean Self-Distillation for Robust Audio LLMs
papers.q1: Audio LLMs are fragile under real-world noise, which causes semantic drift and hallucination, and existing fixes rely on enhancement or answer-level supervision.
papers.q2: The noisy-audio student samples candidate responses; a frozen clean-audio teacher scores them, giving a masked token-level KL alignment and a consistency bonus inside GRPO with audio-aware reward shaping.
papers.q3: Tested with Qwen2.5-Omni, MiniCPM-o-2.6 and Step-Audio2, trained on noise-augmented MMAR data and evaluated on MMAU.
papers.q4: It depends on a reliable clean-audio teacher, adds training-time compute for rollouts and scoring, and targets single-audio understanding.
papers.q1_zh: 音频大模型在真实噪声下很脆弱，容易出现语义漂移和幻觉，现有方法多依赖信号增强或答案级监督。
papers.q2_zh: 带噪音频学生采样候选回答，冻结的干净音频教师对其打分，既提供带掩码的token级KL对齐，又作为一致性奖励加入GRPO，并配合音频感知的奖励塑形。
papers.q3_zh: 在Qwen2.5-Omni、MiniCPM-o-2.6和Step-Audio2上实验，使用加噪的MMAR数据训练并在MMAU上评测。
papers.q4_zh: 方法依赖可靠的干净音频教师，采样与打分增加训练开销，且主要针对单音频理解。

papers.title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
papers.q1: Video generation for interactive social platforms needs real-time, long-horizon audio-visual output, which existing world models aimed at physical or game environments do not address.
papers.q2: MaineCoon is a 22B real-time audio-visual autoregressive model; in ROPD the student generates groups of candidate chunks, a verifier gives binary rewards, and frozen domain-expert LoRA teachers supply targets mixed by a reward-dependent weight.
papers.q3: Evaluated as a streaming audio-visual generator on a single GPU, reaching up to 47.5 FPS.
papers.q4: It covers only the generative core of a social world model; memory, planning and user-state simulation remain open.
papers.q1_zh: 面向互动社交平台的视频生成需要实时、长时程的音视频输出，而现有针对物理或游戏环境的世界模型并未解决这一需求。
papers.q2_zh: MaineCoon是22B参数的实时音视频自回归模型；在ROPD中，学生生成成组候选片段，验证器给出二值奖励，冻结的领域专家LoRA教师提供目标，并按与奖励相关的权重混合。
papers.q3_zh: 作为流式音视频生成模型在单GPU上评测，帧率最高达47.5 FPS。
papers.q4_zh: 仅覆盖社交世界模型的生成核心，记忆、规划和用户状态模拟仍待解决。
